articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia calls for mutual guarantees for lasting regional security at Mediterranean Dialogues
articles.originalDescription: NAPLES — Advisor and Special Envoy of the Minister of Foreign Affairs for Negotiations and Peace Efforts Manal Radwan affirmed that Saudi Arabia remains steadfast in pursuing a balanced strategy that combines containment, deterrence, and dialogue to safeguard regional peace and stability. She emphasized that the Kingdom’s unwavering commitment to defending its national security, preserving the security and stability of the Gulf, and protecting the vital waterways of the Strait of Hormuz and Bab al-Mandab Strait extends far beyond the region, serving the interests of the entire world. Radwan made the remarks while addressing a session titled "Redefining Security: Iran, the Straits, and the Future of the Regional Order" at the Mediterranean Dialogues (MED) conference in Naples, Italy. She called for a sustainable regional security architecture in which each state's security is linked to that of its neighbors and not achieved at another's expense, founded on mutual security guarantees, so that the end of one round of conflict does not merely set the stage for a more violent one. “Temporary arrangements will not work unless they are aligned with long-term strategic frameworks. Dealing with armed groups outside state control requires a political vision, not only a security one, that addresses the local causes of their emergence and their links to the external parties that support and exploit them,” she said.Radwan said Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) member states are united in their objectives and that their roles should complement one another in supporting mediation, de-escalation, and the prevention of a new war, paving the way for confidence-building. “Regional dialogue and international stability are closely linked, and there is no place in the region for any hegemonic power,” she emphasized.On Yemen, Radwan said the war is at its core an intra-Yemeni conflict, and the Kingdom supports a resolution through political and economic tracks in line with the UN-led roadmap

articles.title: Arab Saudi mendeportasi 11.915 warga ilegal dalam seminggu
articles.description: RIYADH - otoritas keamanan Saudi menangkap 10,783 warga ilegal dalam seminggu. Penangkapan dilakukan dalam pemeriksaan bersama, dilakukan oleh pasukan keamanan dalam kolaborasi dengan lembaga-lembaga pemerintah yang relevan, selama periode antara 12 November dan 18, Kementerian Dalam Negeri diumumkan pada hari Sabtu. Mereka yang ditangkap termasuk 5.718 pelanggar Hukum Residensi, 2.797 pelanggar Hukum Keamanan Perbatasan, dan 2.268 pelanggar Hukum Tenaga Kerja. Total penduduk ilegal 11.915 dideportasi sementara 23.250 pelanggar disebut misi diplomatik mereka untuk mendapatkan dokumen perjalanan dan 10,814 pelanggar disebut untuk menyelesaikan pemesanan perjalanan mereka. Jumlah total orang yang ditangkap saat mencoba untuk menyeberangi perbatasan ke Kingdom terhitung 1.373. Total 28 orang ditangkap saat mencoba meninggalkan Kerajaan secara ilegal. Beberapa 14 orang terlibat dalam memberikan transportasi, tempat tinggal, dan pekerjaan untuk pelanggar juga ditangkap. Total ekspatriat 40.941, termasuk 38.730 pria dan 2.211 perempuan, saat ini menjalani prosedur untuk melakukan tindakan hukum untuk pelanggaran. Kementerian Dalam Negeri telah memperingatkan bahwa setiap orang, yang memfasilitasi entri ilegal individu ke Kerajaan, mengangkut mereka di wilayahnya, menyediakan tempat tinggal atau bantuan atau jasa lainnya, akan dihukum hingga 15 tahun penjara dan denda hingga SR1 juta, dan kendaraan yang digunakan untuk transportasi atau rumah yang digunakan untuk memberikan perlindungan akan disita. Menteri mendesak publik untuk melaporkan setiap kasus pelanggaran dengan menelepon nomor 911 di daerah Mekah, Riyadh, dan Provinsi Timur dan nomor 999 dan 996 di sisa wilayah Kerajaan.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia deports 11,915 illegal residents in a week
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi security authorities arrested a total of 10,783 illegal residents in a week. The arrests were made in the joint inspections, carried out by the security forces in collaboration with the relevant government agencies, during the period between November 12 and 18, the Ministry of Interior announced on Saturday. Those who were arrested include 5,718 violators of the Residency Law, 2,797 violators of the Border Security Law, and 2,268 violators of the Labor Law. A total of 11,915 illegal residents were deported while 23,250 violators were referred to their diplomatic missions to obtain travel documents and 10,814 violators were referred to complete their travel reservations. The total number of people who were arrested while trying to cross the border into the Kingdom accounted for 1,373. A total of 28 people were arrested while attempting to leave the Kingdom illegally. Some 14 people involved in giving transportation, shelter, and employment for violators were also arrested. A total of 40,941 expatriates, including 38,730 men and 2,211 women, are currently undergoing procedures to enforce legal measures for violations. The Ministry of Interior has warned that any person, who facilitates the illegal entry of individuals into the Kingdom, transports them on its territory, provides them with shelter or any other assistance or service, will be penalized with up to 15 years in prison and a fine of up to SR1 million, and that the vehicles used for transportation or houses used for giving shelter will be confiscated. The ministry urged the public to report any cases of violation by calling the number 911 in the regions of Makkah, Riyadh, and the Eastern Province and the numbers 999 and 996 in the rest of the Kingdom’s regions.

articles.originalTitle: 'Will throw keys back to UN': Trump-appointed Board of Peace adviser says Israel blocking efforts
articles.originalDescription: 'Will throw keys back to UN': Trump-appointed Board of Peace adviser says Israel blocking efforts Submitted by Daniel Tester on Sat, 11/21/2026 - 13:27 The board said it was frustrated by Israel's obstructions while Gaza remains trapped in a deepening humanitarian crisis Palestinians walk past destroyed buildings and displacement tents in Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip, 17 November 2026 (Eyad Baba/AFP) Off A senior adviser to the US -led Board of Peace for Gaza has said that the panel will "throw the keys back to the UN" if Israel continues to block efforts to prepare for an international stabilisation force and disarm Hamas. “We have been extremely patient and have given Israel its space,” US official Josh Gruenbaum told the Israeli news site Ynet in an interview published on Friday. Chaired by US President Donald Trump, the Board of Peace was given a sweeping mandate by the UN Security Council in November 2025 to establish an international stabilisation force in Gaza as part of a 20-point plan to end hostilities and rehabilitate the devastated enclave. articles.title: Investor asing menyuntikkan SR786 juta ke dalam 131 Saudi-terdaftar perusahaan
articles.description: RIYADH - Investor asing membeli total 34,9 juta saham, dihargai sekitar SR786 juta, pada Pertukaran Saham Saudi (Tadabul). Menurut laporan perubahan kepemilikan asing, meliputi minggu perdagangan berakhir November 19, kepemilikan mereka meningkat 131 perusahaan terdaftar pada Tadaul. Sementara itu, investor asing mengurangi kepemilikan mereka pada 197 perusahaan lain dengan menjual 53.3 juta saham senilai sekitar SR929 juta. Kepemilikan mereka tetap tidak berubah di 71 perusahaan lain. Indeks utama pasar saham Saudi, Tadabul, mengakhiri minggu dengan 167,6 poin, atau 1,6 persen, dari minggu sebelumnya, menutup pada 10,158,9 poin. Sementara itu, indeks pasar paralel, Nomu, ditolak 337.72 poin, atau 1,5 persen, selama periode yang sama, penutupan pada 21.716.4 poin.
articles.originalTitle: Foreign investors inject SR786 million into 131 Saudi-listed companies
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Foreign investors purchased a total of 34.9 million shares, valued at approximately SR786 million, on the Saudi Stock Exchange (Tadawul). According to a report on changes in foreign ownership, covering the trading week ended November 19, their holdings increased in 131 companies listed on Tadawul. Meanwhile, foreign investors reduced their holdings in 197 other companies by selling 53.3 million shares worth approximately SR929 million. Their ownership remained unchanged in 71 other companies. The Saudi stock market’s main index, Tadawul, ended the week down 167.6 points, or 1.6 percent, from the previous week, closing at 10,158.9 points. Meanwhile, the parallel market index, Nomu, declined by 337.72 points, or 1.5 percent, over the same period, closing at 21,716.4 points.

Without any warning, it dropped the two boxes of explosives on to our roof. I was terrified for my children's lives. I grabbed them and rushed out of the house, knowing the explosives could detonate at any moment. We couldn't take anything with us.” Panic spread as families watched more Israeli drones dropping explosives on to rooftops across the neighbourhood. Dozens were forced to flee their homes, with nowhere to go. A group of residents gathered at a distance, watching as the quadcopter drones continued to drop explosives. Minutes later, the devices on the rooftops began detonating. articles.title: Aktivis Pro-Palestina Fergie Chambers dibebaskan, mengatakan 'pengorbananku sangat kecil'
articles.description: Aktivis ProPalestina Fergie Chambers dibebaskan, mengatakan 'pengorbananku sangat kecil' Pengadilan Tinggi Spanyol telah merilis pro- aktivis Palestina dan ahli waris media AS Fergie Chambers dengan jaminan kondisional, sementara mempertimbangkan permintaan ekstradisi oleh AS, menurut putusan pengadilan dirilis pada hari Jumat. Pengadilan memutuskan untuk membebaskan Chambers setelah pihak berwenang AS mengakui apa yang mereka deskripsikan sebagai kesalahan substansial dan tidak disengaja dalam terjemahan Spanyol pernyataan sumpah seorang agen FBI diajukan dalam mendukung permintaan ekstradisi. Pada rilis, Chambers mengatakan kepada Reuters ia percaya tuduhan terhadap dirinya tidak berdasar dan politik termotivasi, menambahkan bahwa ia telah sendirian di sel untuk apa "merasa seperti waktu yang lama". "Saya senang bahwa ini adalah langkah ke arah yang benar", katanya. Chambers menambahkan: "Pada akhirnya, saya mengerti bahwa sebagian besar pengorbanan yang harus saya buat sangat, sangat kecil dalam hubungannya dengan perjuangan bahwa kita semua bagian dari rakyat Palestina, untuk pembebasan mereka, untuk kedaulatan mereka, untuk penghormatan mereka, untuk hak untuk hidup". "Tapi dalam konteks hanya sendirian dalam sel sepanjang waktu, rasanya seperti waktu yang lama. Aku hanya merindukan keluargaku. Saya sangat merindukan keluarga dan teman-teman saya", kata Chambers. Chambers, yang keluarganya memiliki Cox Enterprises, ditangkap atas permintaan otoritas AS pada tanggal 10 Juli saat berlibur di Ibiza. Dia telah ditahan sejak tuduhan termasuk kerusuhan, konspirasi untuk melakukan kerusuhan dan pencucian uang internasional. Chambers, yang nama lengkapnya adalah James Cox Chambers Jr, menyangkal kesalahan. Pengacara Chambers bilang mereka menantang serangan oleh polisi Irlandia di rumah keluarganya di Dublin, yang katanya dilakukan atas permintaan otoritas AS dan melibatkan penyitaan perangkat elektronik dan properti lainnya. articles.originalTitle: Pro-Palestine activist Fergie Chambers released, says 'my sacrifice is very small'
articles.originalDescription: Pro-Palestine activist Fergie Chambers released, says 'my sacrifice is very small' Spain's High Court has released pro-Palestinian activist and US media heir Fergie Chambers on conditional bail, while it considers an extradition request by the US, according to a court ruling released on Friday. The court said it had decided to release Chambers after US authorities acknowledged what they described as substantial and unintentional errors in the Spanish translation of an FBI agent's sworn statement submitted in support of the extradition request. On his release, Chambers told Reuters he believed the accusations against him were baseless and politically motivated, adding that he had been alone in a cell for what "felt like a long time". "I'm glad that this is a step in the right direction," he said. Chambers added: "At the end of the day, I understand that most of the sacrifice I've had to make is very, very small in relation to the struggle that we are all a part of for the Palestinian people, for their liberation, for their sovereignty, for their respect, for the right to live." "But in the context of just being alone in a cell all the time, it feels like a long time. I just missed my family. I really missed my family and my friends,” Chambers said. Chambers, whose family owns Cox Enterprises, was arrested at the request of US authorities on 10 July while on holiday in Ibiza. He has been held in custody ever since on accusations including riot, conspiracy to commit riot and international money laundering. Chambers, whose full name is James Cox Chambers Jr, denies wrongdoing. Separately, Chambers' lawyers said they were challenging a raid by Irish police on his family home in Dublin, which they said was conducted at the request of US authorities and involved the seizure of electronic devices and other property. articles.description: Tujuh orang Gazans terluka, satu yang kritis, dalam tembakan dan serangan udara Israel Tujuh orang Palestina terluka, salah satunya kritis, dalam tembakan dan serangan udara Israel di Gaza pada hari Sabtu pagi, Wafa melaporkan. Dua orang Palestina ditembak oleh pasukan Israel di kamp perpindahannya di kota Jabalia, sebelah utara Strip, sementara seorang wanita dan seorang anak terluka setelah tank melepaskan tembakan berat terhadap tenda orang-orang yang mengungsi di Al- Mawasi daerah Khan Younis, di Gaza selatan, Wafa mengatakan. Sementara itu, tiga orang Palestina terluka, salah satunya kritis, dalam serangan udara Israel menargetkan daerah selatan Al- Mawasi di Khan Younis. Menurut otoritas kesehatan Gaza, lebih dari 1.600 Palestina telah terbunuh dan lebih dari 6.000 terluka sejak gencatan senjata dimulai pada bulan Oktober tahun lalu. articles.originalTitle: Seven Gazans wounded, one critically, in Israeli gunfire and airstrikes
articles.originalDescription: Seven Gazans wounded, one critically, in Israeli gunfire and airstrikes Seven Palestinians were injured, one of them critically, in Israeli gunfire and airstrikes across Gaza on Saturday morning, Wafa reported. Two Palestinians were shot by Israeli forces in displacement camps in the town of Jabalia, north of the Strip, while a woman and a child were wounded after tanks opened heavy fire towards tents for the displaced people in the Al-Mawasi area of Khan Younis, in southern Gaza, Wafa said. Meanwhile, three Palestinians were injured, one of them critically, in an Israeli airstrike targeting an area south of Al-Mawasi in Khan Younis. According to Gaza health authorities, more than 1,600 Palestinians have been killed and over 6,000 wounded since the ceasefire began in October last year. articles.title: Kelompok hak panggilan untuk larangan fosfor putih, mengutip penggunaan Israel di Gaza
articles.description: Kelompok hak asasi menyerukan larangan fosfor putih, mengutip penggunaan Israel di kelompok hak-hak Gaza, Maat for Peace, Development and Human Rights, telah menyerukan larangan eksplisit atas penggunaan fosfor putih, yang telah berulang kali digunakan oleh Israel di Gaza dan Lebanon selatan, Al Jazeera melaporkan. Fosfor putih dapat menyebabkan luka bakar yang parah, terbakar berulang kali dan menghasilkan panas yang intens dan asap beracun. Kelompok hak asasi manusia dan The New York Times mengatakan pada bulan Juni mereka telah mendokumentasikan penggunaan Israel dari chemical white fosfor di daerah sipil Lebanon. Fosfor putih tidak dilarang di bawah hukum internasional, tetapi adalah ilegal untuk menggunakan bahan kimia di dan dekat daerah penduduk karena dapat menyebabkan kerusakan luas. Israel telah dituduh oleh komunitas hak asasi manusia internasional selama beberapa dekade menggunakan zat tersebut dengan cara yang membahayakan warga sipil. Dalam kertas kerja yang diajukan pada sesi tinjauan untuk Konvensi PBB pada Senjata Konvensi tertentu, kelompok mengatakan perjanjian saat ini telah melotot celah yang memungkinkan untuk penggunaan fosfor putih. Setelah penusukan setelah pembicaraan dimulai pada hari Senin, konferensi berjalan dari waktu ke waktu dan berakhir lebih awal pada hari Sabtu, dengan negara-negara setuju untuk terus berbicara ditujukan pada langkah-langkah mengembangkan senjata otonom mematikan pada tahun 2028.
articles.originalTitle: Rights group calls for ban on white phosphorus, cites Israel's use in Gaza
articles.originalDescription: Rights group calls for ban on white phosphorus, cites Israel's use in Gaza Cairo-based rights group, Maat for Peace, Development and Human Rights, has called for an explicit ban on the use of white phosphours, which has repeatedly been used by Israel in Gaza and southern Lebanon, Al Jazeera reported. White phosphorus can cause severe burns, ignite repeatedly and produce intense heat and toxic smoke. Human rights groups and The New York Times said in June they have documented Israel's use of the chemical white phosphorus over civilian areas in Lebanon. White phosphorus is not banned under international law, but it is illegal to use the chemical in and near populated areas since it can cause widespread harm. Israel has been accused by the international human rights community for decades of using the substance in a way that puts civilians in danger. In a working paper submitted at the review session for the UN Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons, the group said the current treaty has glaring gaps that allow for the use of white phosphorus. Following an impasse after talks started on Monday, the conference ran over time and ended early on Saturday, with states agreeing to continue talks aimed at developing measures on lethal autonomous weapons by 2028.

articles.title: Gaza Board of Peace mengatakan itu akan memberikan kunci kepada PBB jika Israel gagal untuk menghormati komitmen
articles.description: Gaza Board of Peace mengatakan akan memberikan kunci kepada PBB jika Israel gagal untuk menghormati komitmen Seorang penasihat senior Trump- diangkat Gaza Dewan Perdamaian telah memperingatkan bahwa tubuh bisa kembali tanggung jawab untuk masuk ke PBB jika Israel tidak menghormati komitmennya di bawah rencana 20 - titik, Israel outlet Ynet telah melaporkan. Josh Gruenbaum, yang ditunjuk dewan oleh Trump dan sebelumnya bekerja di Gedung Putih, mengatakan kepada Ynet: "Kami telah sangat sabar dan telah memberikan Israel ruang. Tapi itu membuat frustasi bahwa sekarang dengan pemilu di belakang kami - bahkan jika mereka belum menghasilkan koalisi yang jelas - bahwa Israel gagal untuk bergerak maju pada komitmen Netanyahu dibuat untuk Presiden Trump." "Jika kepemimpinan politik ini mengatakan tidak lagi ingin menghormati apa yang mereka berkomitmen untuk, biarkan kami tahu", kata Gruenbaum "Dan kami akan melemparkan kunci kembali ke PBB". Ynet mengatakan telah melihat presentasi yang disiapkan oleh anggota dewan, yang mengunjungi Israel minggu lalu. Slide terakhir, berjudul "alternatif lain untuk Gaza", dilaporkan daftar beberapa skenario jika rencananya ditinggalkan. Ini termasuk administrasi dan Kongres AS masa depan yang memesan rencana rekonstruksi yang berbeda, Dewan Keamanan PBB mengambil alih "mungkin melalui UNRWA", Otoritas Palestina dan Hamas. Skenario terakhir, menurut slide, adalah Israel menjadi sepenuhnya bertanggung jawab atas biaya administrasi dan kemanusiaan penduduk Gaza. Slide lainnya dilaporkan mengatakan Hamas secara resmi menerima rencana tersebut pada bulan Juli, berjanji untuk menyerahkan senjata dan mentransfer kekuatan pemerintah kepada Komite Nasional untuk Administrasi Gaza (NCAG), tubuh teknologi yang dimaksudkan untuk menjalankan wilayah tersebut. "Kami terhenti karena unsur-unsur politik dalam pemerintah Netanyahu yang telah mencegah kami dari kemajuan dan dari pengujian apakah Hamas akan menepati janjinya", kata Gruenbaum, menurut Ynet. G
articles.originalTitle: Gaza Board of Peace says it will hand keys to UN if Israel fails to honour commitments
articles.originalDescription: Gaza Board of Peace says it will hand keys to UN if Israel fails to honour commitments A senior adviser to the Trump-appointed Gaza Peace Council has warned that the body could return responsibility for the enclave to the United Nations if Israel does not honour its commitments under the 20-point plan, Israeli outlet Ynet has reported. Josh Gruenbaum, who was appointed to the council by Trump and previously worked in the White House, told Ynet: “We have been extremely patient and have given Israel its space. But it is frustrating that now with the elections behind us — even if they haven’t resulted in a clear coalition — that Israel is failing to move forward on the commitments Netanyahu made to President Trump.” “If this political leadership says it no longer wants to honour what they committed to, just let us know,” Gruenbaum said “And we will throw the keys back to the UN.” Ynet said it had seen a presentation prepared by council members, who visited Israel last week. Its final slide, titled “Other alternatives to Gaza”, reportedly lists several scenarios if the plan is abandoned. These include a future US administration and Congress ordering a different reconstruction plan, the UN Security Council taking over “perhaps through UNRWA”, the Palestinian Authority and Hamas. The last scenario, according to the slide, is that Israel becomes fully responsible for the administrative and humanitarian costs of Gaza’s population. Another slide reportedly says Hamas formally accepted the plan in July, pledging to give up its weapons and transfer governmental powers to the National Committee for the Administration of Gaza (NCAG), the technocratic body meant to run the territory. “We are at a standstill due to political elements within the Netanyahu government who have prevented us from progressing and from testing whether Hamas will keep its word,” Gruenbaum said, according to Ynet. articles.title: Israel tidak melakukan panggilan untuk melindungi petani zaitun Palestina, kata Ocha
articles.description: Israel tidak melakukan panggilan untuk melindungi petani zaitun Palestina, Ocha mengatakan bahwa panggilan kepada pihak berwenang Israel untuk melindungi para petani zaitun Palestina dan memastikan mereka dapat mencapai padang rumput mereka dengan aman belum dilakukan, Kantor PBB untuk koordinasi Urusan Kemanusiaan (Ocha) mengatakan, mengutip Tim Negara Kemanusiaan. Sebaliknya, dalam sembilan bulan pertama 2026, pemerintah Israel merosot atau merusak lebih dari 10.000 pohon Palestina dan saplings di seluruh Tepi Barat, kebanyakan zaitun, pernyataan menambahkan. Tim Negara Kemanusiaan untuk Wilayah Palestina, yang membawa tubuh PBB dan LSM kemanusiaan, mengatakan lebih dari 400 pemukim Israel menyerang pada panen zaitun Palestina sejak September telah mengakibatkan korban atau kerusakan properti, termasuk lebih dari 4.000 pohon dan saplings. Jumlah serangan tahun ini melebihi yang direkam dalam musim panen zaitun sebelumnya. Tahun ini jendela panen ditutup, kata tim, tapi masih ada beberapa waktu untuk bertindak. "LSM Kemanusiaan dan agen-agen PBB mendesak pemerintah Israel dengan cara yang paling mungkin: mengakhiri semua serangan terhadap Palestina dan mata pencaharian mereka, sesuai dengan hukum internasional. Pastikan petani memiliki akses bebas, aman, cukup dan dapat diandalkan ke tanah mereka. Tim menambahkan bahwa pelaku harus dihentikan dan diadakan untuk account," pernyataan yang dibaca.
articles.originalTitle: Israel has not acted on calls to protect Palestinian olive farmers, Ocha says
articles.originalDescription: Israel has not acted on calls to protect Palestinian olive farmers, Ocha says Calls on the Israeli authorities to protect Palestinian olive farmers and ensure they can reach their groves safely have not been acted upon, the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (Ocha) said, citing the Humanitarian Country Team. Instead, in the first nine months of 2026, Israeli authorities uprooted or otherwise damaged more than 10,000 Palestinian-owned trees and saplings across the West Bank, mostly olives, the statement adds. The Humanitarian Country Team for the Occupied Palestinian Territory, which brings together UN bodies and humanitarian NGOs, said more than 400 Israeli settler attacks on the Palestinian olive harvest since September have resulted in casualties or damage to property, including to more than 4,000 trees and saplings. The number of attacks this year exceeds that recorded in any previous olive harvest season. This year’s harvesting window is closing, the team said, but there is still some time to act. "Humanitarian NGOs and UN agencies urge the Israeli authorities in the strongest possible terms: end all attacks on Palestinians and their livelihoods, as required by international law. Ensure farmers have free, safe, sufficient and reliable access to their land. The team added that perpetrators must be stopped and held to account," the statement read.

articles.title: UNDP resmi: 'Penderitaan Gaza harus memaksa kita untuk menanyakan pertanyaan sulit'
articles.description: Secara resmi UNDP: 'Penderitaan Gaza harus memaksa kita untuk menanyakan pertanyaan yang sulit' Programme Pengembangan PBB Teratas (UNDP) mengatakan penderitaan yang dialami oleh orang-orang di Gaza "harus memaksa kita untuk mengajukan pertanyaan yang sulit". "Apa yang menyerang Anda segera adalah skala kehancuran di Gaza, di mana lebih dari 90% dari populasi tergantung pada bantuan kemanusiaan. Perbedaan antara apa yang kita anggap normal - makanan, air dan kualitas hidup - dan penderitaan yang dialami oleh orang-orang di Gaza harus memaksa kita untuk mengajukan pertanyaan yang sulit," Haolang Xu, Under- Sekretaris - Jenderal dan Administrator Asosiasi, UNDP, kata. Xu mengatakan fitur mendefinisikan waktu kita adalah "polikrisis, dengan tantangan yang jauh melampaui setiap tempat", menurut posting pada X oleh DIalogues MED. "Konflik di Timur Tengah, misalnya, adalah biaya negara di seluruh wilayah setidaknya 3,6% dari PDB, dengan beberapa perkiraan UNDP mencapai 6%", kata Xu.
articles.originalTitle: UNDP official: 'Gaza's suffering must compel us to ask difficult questions'
articles.originalDescription: UNDP official: 'Gaza's suffering must compel us to ask difficult questions' A top United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) official has said the suffering endured by people in Gaza "must compel us to ask difficult questions". “What strikes you immediately is the scale of the destruction in Gaza, where more than 90% of the population depends on humanitarian assistance. The contrast between what we consider normal—food, water and quality of life—and the suffering endured by people in Gaza must compel us to ask difficult questions,” Haoliang Xu, Under-Secretary-General and Associate Administrator, UNDP, said. Xu said a defining feature of our time is "polycrisis, with challenges that extend far beyond any one place", according to a post on X by MED Dialogues. "The conflict in the Middle East, for example, is costing countries across the region at least 3.6% of GDP, with some UNDP estimates reaching 6%,” Xu said.

articles.description: Trump: 'ICC di luar kendali, tidak bisa masuk dan menangkap kepala negara' Presiden AS Donald Trump mengatakan Pengadilan Pidana Internasional adalah "di luar kendali", sambil mengklaim Cina "setuju untuk pertama kalinya untuk mengutuk pelanggaran dan melampaui" pengadilan, laporan AFP. Trump, saat kembali dari pertemuan dengan Xi Jinping dan Vladimir Putin dari Rusia, mengeluh bahwa ICC percaya "mereka bisa masuk dan menangkap para kepala negara, dan mereka tidak bisa melakukan itu. Mereka bisa melakukannya tanpa alasan -- jadi kita mengutuk itu sebagai kelompok". Washington telah bersumpah untuk membongkar pengadilan, yang ditargetkan dengan sanksi baru bulan lalu. Trump telah marah dengan pergerakan pengadilan untuk mengeluarkan surat penangkapan untuk Perdana Menteri Israel Benjamin Netanyahu atas pembantaian Gaza. Washington telah bersumpah untuk membongkar pengadilan, yang ditargetkan dengan sanksi baru bulan lalu. (AFP)

articles.originalDescription: Trump: 'ICC out of control, can't go in and arrest heads of countries' US President Donald Trump has said the International Criminal Court was "out of control", while claiming China "agreed for the first time to condemn the abuses and overreach" of the court, AFP reported. Trump, on his return from a summit with China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin, complained that the ICC believes "they can go in and arrest the heads of countries, and they can't do that. They can do it for no reason -- so we condemned that as a group." Washington has vowed to dismantle the court, which it targeted with new sanctions last month. Trump has been angered by the tribunal's move to issue an arrest warrant for Israel's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu over Gaza genocide. articles.title: Enam orang Palestina tewas dalam serangan Israel di Gaza, pertahanan sipil mengatakan
articles.description: Enam orang Palestina tewas dalam serangan Israel di Gaza, pertahanan sipil mengatakan Israel menyerang enam orang di Jalur Gaza pada hari Jumat, lembaga pertahanan sipil di medan perang hancur wilayah mengatakan AFP, meskipun gencatan senjata. Mahmoud Bassal, juru bicara lembaga pertahanan sipil Gaza, mengatakan bahwa empat orang Palestina tewas dan beberapa lainnya terluka dalam serangan udara Israel barat daya kamp pengungsi Bureij di pusat Jalur Gaza pada hari Jumat. Pertahanan sipil juga mengatakan satu Palestina tewas dalam serangan pesawat tak berawak Israel menargetkan sebuah tenda di kamp Al- Munasara untuk pengungsi orang di Deir Al- Balah. Orang lain tewas dalam serangan pesawat tak berawak utara kamp pengungsi Nuseyat, juga di Jalur Gaza Tengah. Militer Israel mengatakan kepada AFP itu telah "ditargetkan beberapa koperasi militer" dalam beberapa serangan, yang datang sehari setelah tentara mengatakan telah menyelesaikan serangan tanah di Jalur Gaza pusat. Lebih dari 1.600 warga Palestina telah terbunuh sejak dimulainya gencatan senjata, menurut perhitungan AFP berdasarkan data dari Departemen Kesehatan Gaza yang jumlahnya dianggap dapat diandalkan oleh PBB. articles.originalTitle: Six Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza, civil defence says
articles.originalDescription: Six Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza, civil defence says Israeli strikes killed six people in the Gaza Strip on Friday, the civil defence agency in the war-shattered territory told AFP, despite a ceasefire. Mahmoud Bassal, the spokesman for Gaza's civil defence agency, said that four Palestinians were killed and several others wounded in an Israeli airstrike southwest of Bureij refugee camp in the central Gaza Strip on Friday. The civil defence also said one Palestinian was killed in an Israeli drone strike targeting a tent in the Al-Munasara camp for displaced people in Deir al-Balah. Another person was killed in a drone strike north of Nuseirat refugee camp, also in the central Gaza Strip. The Israeli military told AFP it had "targeted multiple military operatives" in several strikes, which came a day after the army said it had completed a ground incursion in the central Gaza Strip. More than 1,600 Palestinians have been killed since the start of the ceasefire, according to an AFP tally based on data from the Gaza health ministry whose figures are considered reliable by the United Nations. Report by AFP

The civil defence sent a second message soon afterwards saying the danger had passed. The cause of the boom was not immediately clear. It was the first such alert in Riyadh since a Houthi attack struck the capital’s tallest skyscraper on Thursday. articles.originalTitle: Inside the Iraqi Kurdish city caught between the US and Iran
articles.originalDescription: Inside the Iraqi Kurdish city caught between the US and Iran Submitted by Sean Mathews on Fri, 11/20/2026 - 19:37 Sulaymaniyah is reeling from the economic toll of the Iran war and grappling with an emboldened regional power next door A market in the city of Sulaymaniyah in Iraq's Kurdistan Region is said to be the largest bazaar in the region, on 11 November 2026 (Sean Mathews/MEE) Off If US President Donald Trump has his way, Baran* will be out of business. The thirty-year-old Kurd is a trader who buys diesel in Iraq and sells it in Afghanistan. It’s a stressful gig, but one that can generate a tidy profit in a place like Iraqi Kurdistan. A truck laden with $20,000 worth of diesel in Iraq can sell in Kabul for around $24,000, leaving around $2,000 for the trader once expenses are paid. But it has to make it through Iran first. “The journey is more dangerous now. It’s harder to find drivers. The border isn’t as reliable. The price of diesel has also shot up,” Baran, whose name has been changed to protect his identity, told Middle East Eye. Trump says instead of restarting strikes on Iran, he wants to choke its economy. In addition to a naval blockade, the US is pressing countries like Turkey , Iraq and Pakistan to seal their borders with Iran. Earlier this month, the US announced a task force to blockade trade across Iran’s land borders and the Caspian Sea. Baran has no political beef with the US. On the contrary, he says, “George W. Bush overthrew Saddam Hussein. He helped Kurdistan. articles.title: Pembalasan atas serangan koalisi terhadap pembangkit listrik Saudi.
articles.description: Pembalasan atas serangan koalisi terhadap pembangkit listrik Saudi dan pelabuhan Yemen pada hari Jumat mengatakan bahwa mereka telah menyerang pembangkit listrik di Arab Saudi Al- Shuqaiq dan pelabuhan Jizan, dalam menanggapi Saudi-dipimpin koalisi menyerang Yaman. "Dengan bantuan Tuhan, angkatan bersenjata kami melakukan operasi militer presisi menargetkan pembangkit listrik Al- Shuqaiq dan Pelabuhan Jizan. Serangan itu akurat dan langsung, menyebabkan kerusakan parah," Juru bicara militer Houthi Yahya Saree mengatakan pada X Saree bilang serangan itu merupakan respon atas serangan koalisi terhadap pembangkit listrik Saada dan Mokha, dan pada salah satu badai di pelabuhan Hodeidah lebih awal pada hari itu. "Kami meyakinkan musuh Saudi bahwa setiap serangan di Port of Hodeidah atau stasiun daya akan bertemu dengan respon langsung menargetkan pelabuhan dan stasiun listrik", katanya. Pada hari Jumat, koalisi meluncurkan apa yang disebut "operasi khusus", menyerang Hodeidah juga target di Sanaa, Saada dan Taiz. Houthis mengatakan serangan menewaskan 41 orang dalam 24 jam terakhir.
articles.originalTitle: Houthis retaliate for coalition strikes with attack on Saudi power station and port
articles.originalDescription: Houthis retaliate for coalition strikes with attack on Saudi power station and port Yemen’s Houthis said on Friday that they had attacked a power station in Saudi Arabia’s Al-Shuqaiq and the port of Jizan, in response to Saudi-led coalition strikes on Yemen. “With God’s help, our armed forces carried out a precision military operation targeting the Al-Shuqaiq power station and the Port of Jizan. The strikes were accurate and direct, causing extensive damage,” Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree said on X. Saree said the attack was a response to coalition strikes on the Saada and Mokha power stations, and on one of the quays at Hodeidah port earlier in the day. “We assure the Saudi enemy that any attack on the Port of Hodeidah or power stations will be met with an immediate response targeting its ports and power stations,” he wrote. On Friday, the coalition launched what it called a “special operation”, striking Hodeidah as well as targets in Sanaa, Saada and Taiz. The Houthis said strikes killed 41 people in the past 24 hours.

articles.title: Houthis mengatakan 41 tewas sebagai Saudi- dipimpin koalisi meluncurkan 'operasi khusus' di Yaman
articles.description: Houthis mengatakan 41 tewas sebagai Saudi- dipimpin koalisi meluncurkan 'operasi khusus' di Yaman Saudi- dipimpin koalisi serangan di Yaman menewaskan 41 orang dalam 24 jam terakhir, Houthis mengatakan pada hari Jumat, setelah koalisi menyerang kota pelabuhan Laut Merah Hodeidah dan target lainnya dalam apa yang disebut "operasi khusus". Koalisi mengatakan hal itu memukul penyelundupan dan senjata-transportasi operasi di Hodeidah sementara juga melaksanakan serangan di Sanaa, Saada dan Taiz mengatur. Sementara itu, Houthis telah bersumpah untuk menyerang Jeddah dan pelabuhan Laut Merah Saudi lainnya jika Hodeidah diserang, sementara peringatan penerbangan bahwa udara Saudi "tidak aman". Mereka juga mengancam distrik keuangan Riyadh dan pembangkit listrik di Al- Shuqaiq. "Kami menargetkan kemampuan operasional di pelabuhan Hodeidah yang digunakan dalam operasi penyelundupan dan pengiriman senjata dan rudal balistik", Juru bicara Koalisi Saudi Turki al- Malki diposting di X Koalisi menyerang "target militer" di Sanaa, termasuk fasilitas rudal dan drone dan depot pasokan, ia menambahkan. Dua rudal balistik dicegat selama daerah Jizan dekat perbatasan Yaman, ia diposting kemudian, dengan puing-puing jatuh di Al- Shuqaiq. The Houthis 'Al- Masirah siaran televisi gambar dari pembangkit listrik rusak di Mokha setelah serangan udara koalisi. HANYA DI: Arab Saudi telah melanda pelabuhan Hodeidah Yaman, menjadi negara ketiga untuk menyerang pelabuhan strategis setelah Amerika Serikat dan Israel. Dalam menanggapi Ansarallah memperingatkan bahwa Jeddah, pelabuhan Jizan dan Yanbu, bersama dengan distrik keuangan Riyadh, akan menjadi target. https: / / t.co / lHCVGpfkxf - Laporan Saat ini (@ Recentreporter 1) November 20, 2026
articles.originalTitle: Houthis say 41 killed as Saudi-led coalition launches 'special operation' in Yemen
articles.originalDescription: Houthis say 41 killed as Saudi-led coalition launches 'special operation' in Yemen Saudi-led coalition strikes on Yemen killed 41 people in the past 24 hours, the Houthis said on Friday, after the coalition attacked the Red Sea port city of Hodeidah and other targets in what it called a “special operation”. The coalition said it hit smuggling and weapons-transporting operations in Hodeidah while also carrying out attacks in Sanaa, Saada and Taiz governorates. Meanwhile, Houthis had vowed to hit Jeddah and other Saudi Red Sea ports if Hodeidah was attacked, while warning airlines that Saudi airspace was “unsafe”. They also threatened Riyadh’s financial district and a power station in Al-Shuqaiq. “We targeted operational capabilities at Hodeidah port that were used in smuggling operations and the transport of weapons and ballistic missiles,” Saudi coalition spokesman Turki al-Malki posted on X. The coalition hit “military targets” in Sanaa, including missile and drone facilities and a supply depot, he added. Two ballistic missiles were intercepted over the Jizan region near the Yemen border, he posted later, with debris falling in Al-Shuqaiq. The Houthis’ Al-Masirah television broadcast images of a damaged power station in Mokha after a coalition air raid. JUST IN: Saudi Arabia has struck Yemen's Hodeidah port, becoming the third country to attack the strategic port after the United States and Israel. In response Ansarallah warned that Jeddah, Jizan and Yanbu ports, along with Riyadh's financial district, would be targeted. https://t.co/lHCVGpfkxf — Current Report (@Currentreport1) November 20, 2026

articles.originalTitle: Fergie Chambers released in Spain as US admits court translation errors
articles.originalDescription: Fergie Chambers released in Spain as US admits court translation errors Submitted by Amandla Thomas-Johnson on Fri, 11/20/2026 - 15:53 American pro-Palestinian activist is 'happy to breathe fresh air' following conditional release from prison as he fights US extradition request Fergie Chambers outside Aranjuez prison following his release on Friday, 20 November 2026 (Reuters) Off Fergie Chambers, the American pro-Palestinian donor detained in Spain following a US extradition request, was granted provisional release on Friday after the Trump administration admitted to “substantial” translation errors in court documents submitted in support of its case. Speaking outside Aranjuez prison on Friday following his release, Chambers described the charges against him as “baseless” and said he hoped his release was “the first step in a process of recognising that internationally”. “I think this case is important for human rights, for people who want to speak out anywhere in the world,” he said. The decision by the Criminal Chamber of Spain's National Court, known as the Audiencia Nacional, comes after Chambers had spent more than four months in custody since his arrest in Ibiza in July. In its ruling, seen by Middle East Eye, the court said errors in the translation of documents submitted by US authorities had cast doubt on the reliability of the extradition request and weakened its basis. The judges found that the development appeared to reduce the risk of Chambers fleeing and meant that his continued detention could no longer be justified. His release is subject to several conditions, including weekly appearances before the court nearest his residence every Monday, surrendering his passport, a prohibition on leaving Spain and an obligation to appear before the court whenever summoned. articles.title: Kesepakatan konsep Cop31 'terburuk yang pernah ada', kampanye memperingatkan
articles.description: Kesepakatan konsep Cop31 'yang terburuk yang pernah ada', para kampanye memperingatkan Diberikan oleh Katherine Hearst pada Fri, 11 / 20 / 2026 - 14: 55 Sebuah konsep kedua dari teks kunci merangkum pembicaraan iklim telah mereferensikan sebuah fase dari bahan bakar fosil yang telah dihapus sementara yang berpusat pada teknologi penangkapan karbon Cop31 konferensi iklim diadakan di Antalya Expo Centre di Turki (AFP) dari kampanye keadilan iklim telah memukul keluar pada hasil rancangan pembicaraan iklim global, menggambarkannya sebagai "terburuk" dalam sejarah konferensi tersebut. Perjanjian draft, yang menguraikan komitmen kunci dari konferensi iklim Cop31 di Turki, telah dilucuti dari semua referensi mengenai fase- dari bahan bakar fosil, tetapi didukung "mempercepat penangkapan karbon, utilisasi dan penyimpanan", dimana aktor masyarakat sipil telah dicemooh sebagai "solusi palsu" untuk kerusakan iklim. "Bahasa yang jauh lebih lemah di seluruh front, dan secara keseluruhan, ketika kita melihatnya, agresif, pelacakan balik, dan tidak akan membantu negara-negara berkembang", Harjeet Singh, penasihat strategis ke Fuel Fosil Treatty Initiative, kata Mata Timur Tengah. "Sebaliknya, itu akan membantu sektor swasta, industri bahan bakar fosil, dan itu bukan apa yang kita datang ke sini untuk," kata Singh. "Keputusan penutup" adalah teks overarching yang merangkum hasil negosiasi yang berbeda, berisi janji janji yang dimaksudkan untuk memenuhi tujuan Perjanjian Paris. Sebuah draft awal yang muncul pada hari Senin sangat diedit, dengan banyak komitmen utama, termasuk transisi jauh dari bahan bakar fosil dan target $120bn untuk keuangan untuk membantu negara-negara berkembang beradaptasi dengan krisis iklim, dilucuti. Secara radikal, teks substitusi terbaru komitmen untuk "transisi jauh dari bahan bakar fosil" untuk janji untuk "transisi global tidak dapat dikembalikan menuju emisi gas rumah kaca rendah dan daya tahan iklim". Draft baru ini juga pusat kontroversial teknolog
articles.originalTitle: Cop31 draft agreement ‘the worst ever', campaigners warn
articles.originalDescription: Cop31 draft agreement ‘the worst ever', campaigners warn Submitted by Katherine Hearst on Fri, 11/20/2026 - 14:55 A second draft of the key text summarising the climate talks had references to a phase out of fossil fuels removed while centring carbon capture technologies The Cop31 climate conference is being held at the Antalya Expo Centre in Turkey (AFP) Off Climate justice campaigners have hit out at the draft outcome of the global climate talks, describing it as the “worst” in the conference’s history. The draft agreement, which outlines the key commitments of the Cop31 climate summit in Turkey, was stripped of all references to a phase-out of fossil fuels, but backed “accelerating carbon capture, utilisation and storage”, which civil society actors have derided as a “false solution” to climate breakdown. “It's much weaker language across all fronts, and overall, when we look at it, it’s aggressive, it is backtracking, and it's not going to help developing countries," Harjeet Singh, strategic adviser to the Fossil Fuel Treaty Initiative, told Middle East Eye. "Rather, it is going to help the private sector, fossil fuel industry, and that is not what we came here for,” Singh said. The “cover decision” is an overarching text which summarises the different negotiation outcomes, containing pledges intended to meet the goals of the Paris Agreement. An initial draft which appeared on Monday was heavily edited, with many of the main commitments, including a transition away from fossil fuels and a $120bn target for finance to help developing countries adapt to the climate crisis, stripped out. Crucially, the latest text substitutes a commitment to “transition away from fossil fuels” for a pledge to “irreversible global transition towards low greenhouse gas emissions and climate resilience”. The new draft also centres controversial carbon capture technologies, pledging to increase them 20- to 40-fold by 2035. Cop31: Turkey signs $5.1bn loan deals to boost green transition

Wartawan lokal melaporkan pasukan polisi melewati pos pemeriksaan yang berawak oleh Kataeb Hezbollah di Jurf al- Sakhar, selatan Baghdad. "Pasukan gabungan Irak mulai memasuki area [Jurf al-Sakhar] untuk menyebar kembali ke sana", laporan media negara bagian. Kataeb Hezbollah telah diberikan sampai Jumat untuk menyerahkan kendali daerah tersebut. Perdana Menteri Ali Al- Zaidi telah menempatkan pasukan keamanan di pinggiran, siap untuk masuk dengan paksa. Kesepakatan itu ditengahi oleh pemimpin politik senior Syiah. Esmail Qaani, komandan pasukan elit Iran, juga tiba di Baghdad pada hari Senin untuk membantu meredakan situasi. articles.originalDescription: Saudi-backed forces defend strikes on Yemen's Hodeidah port Saudi-backed forces have defended Saudi Arabia's latest attack on Yemen's civilian port of Hodeidah, with the number of casualties from today's strikes still unknown. Salem al-Awalqi, the information minister in Yemen’s Saudi-backed government, told the government-run Saba news agency that the operation targeted facilities allegedly used by the Houthis to smuggle weapons into Yemen. “The operation targeted specific components of the port facilities used to transport smuggled weapons, particularly ballistic missiles, from smuggling vessels,” he said, accusing the Houthis of dragging the port into the conflict. “We reassure citizens that the flow of essential goods, humanitarian aid, and commercial activities will continue in accordance with established arrangements,” al-Awalqi claimed. articles.description: Film-film Palestina dan Israel menampilkan gambaran realitas yang berbeda di tengah genosida yang difilmkan oleh Joseph Fahim di Fri, 11 / 20 / 2026 - 09: 59 Hosam Abu Dan 's Thirteen di Gaza dan Ahmed Hassouna Citizen Osama difilmkan di tengah kehancuran Tiga belas di Gaza adalah eksplorasi kebusukan moral yang mempengaruhi masyarakat yang mengalami pembantaian (Toronto International Film Festival) Off a year after the so-disebut gencatan senjata perjanjian antara Israel dan Hamas pada Oktober 2025, Palestina dan Israel sinema telah berebut untuk menangkap realitas volatile dibentuk oleh pertanyaan lebih kompleks daripada mereka yang muncul segera setelah 7 Oktober. Mempertahankan martabat seseorang ketika selamat dari kampanye dehumanising yang sadis menargetkan warga sipil adalah penetapan utama dari beberapa film tentang Gaza dirilis antara 2024 dan awal 2026. Musim gugur 2026, bagaimanapun, menawarkan serangkaian pertanyaan yang berbeda: dinamika daya yang sangat tidak simetris antara Israel agresor dan Palestina; kemampuan dari apa yang sekarang menjadi mimpi layu dari dua negara; rasa sakit yang tertinggal untuk tanah air yang hilang, irretrivable; dan yang baru terekspos, tidak menyenangkan realitas ekonomi informal Gaza. Sebagai keberhasilan kolosal NAZA telah dibuat jelas, Gaza akan terus mendominasi narasi bioskop di Palestina untuk masa depan yang bisa diperkirakan. Namun, ketika musim gugur ini tanaman film menunjukkan, dimensi baru secara bertahap akan menjadi fokus sebagai pembuat film Palestina terus bergulat dengan medan tidak pasti posting - 7 Oktober. Sementara itu, perfilman Israel akan tetap terpecah, terjebak antara tekanan yang dihasilkan oleh pemimpin politik Jingoist yang putus asa untuk memberikan negara mereka karakter PR dan dorongan bersaing dari pembuat film kiri berusaha untuk mengembalikan posisi internasional yang berkurang dari sebuah bioskop nasional yang motivasinya hanya dapat dinilai pada kasus-kasus kasus. articles.originalTitle: Palestinian and Israeli films present different shades of reality amid genocide
articles.originalDescription: Palestinian and Israeli films present different shades of reality amid genocide Submitted by Joseph Fahim on Fri, 11/20/2026 - 09:59 Hosam Abu Dan's Thirteen in Gaza and Ahmed Hassouna's Citizen Osama were filmed amid destruction Thirteen in Gaza is an exploration of the moral rot that affects a society undergoing genocide (Toronto International Film Festival) Off A year after the so-called ceasefire agreement between Israel and Hamas in October 2025, Palestinian and Israeli cinemas have been scrambling to capture a volatile reality shaped by questions more complex than those that emerged in the immediate aftermath of 7 October. Maintaining one’s dignity while surviving a sadistically dehumanising campaign targeting civilians was the central preoccupation of the handful of films about Gaza released between 2024 and early 2026. The 2026 autumn season, however, offers a different set of inquiries: the deeply asymmetrical power dynamics between the Israeli aggressor and the Palestinians ; the viability of what has now become the wistful dream of a two-state solution; the lingering ache for a lost, irretrievable homeland; and the newly exposed, unflattering realities of Gaza’s informal economy. As the colossal success of NAZA has made evident, Gaza will continue to dominate cinema's narrative on Palestine for the foreseeable future. Yet, as this fall's crop of films suggests, new dimensions will gradually come into focus as Palestinian filmmakers continue to grapple with uncertain terrain post-7 October. Israeli cinema, meanwhile, will remain divided, caught between the pressure exerted by jingoist political leaders desperate to give their country a PR facelift and the competing impulse of leftist filmmakers seeking to restore the diminished international standing of a national cinema whose motivations can only be assessed on a case-by-case basis. articles.title: Eksklusif: dokter Inggris yang dituduh antisemitisme mencari tindakan hukum terhadap regulator selama kebocoran data pribadi
articles.description: Ekslusif: dokter Inggris yang dituduh antisemitisme mencari tindakan hukum terhadap regulator atas kebocoran data pribadi Diberikan oleh Amara Sophia Elahi pada Fri, 11 / 20 / 2026 - 14: 08 Para dokter mengeluhkan keamanan mereka setelah Majelis Medis Umum membocorkan data kepada para pekerja kesehatan Pro-Palestina yang berkumpul di alun-alun Parlemen London dengan solidaritas-solidaritas para pekerja medis yang mengalami suspensi melalui pos media sosial, pada tanggal 15 Oktober 2025 (Vuk Valcic / ZUMA Press Wire / Reuters) Off Doctors di Inggris yang telah disebut sebagai Dewan Medis Umum (GMC) untuk dugaan antisemitim dan Islamo (Islamo) mempertimbangkan tindakan yang legal di koran tersebut telah menerbitkan surat kabar sakit tersebut. Kebocoran terjadi setelah Permintaan Kebebasan Informasi yang diajukan oleh Times ke GMC, yang meminta untuk jumlah dokter yang telah mengeluh tentang, diselidiki dan disetujui untuk antisemitisme dan Islammophobia sejak Oktober 2023. Dalam responnya, GMC berbagi nomor referensi 223 dokter, yang memungkinkan mereka untuk diidentifikasi melalui publikasi regulator yang menghadap basis data. GMC juga termasuk rincian etnis dokter, di bawah hukum Inggris adalah karakteristik yang dilindungi. Dalam sebuah surat yang dikirim kepada kelompok dokter minggu ini, Claire Light, kepala kesetaraan GMC, keragaman dan penyertaan, menyatakan bahwa data internal telah dibagikan kepada The Times "dalam kesalahan, dan regulator secara resmi meminta melalui pengacara mereka bahwa surat kabar menghapus data rahasia dan tidak menyebarkannya. The Times telah mengatakan kepada GMC bahwa itu tidak akan mempublikasikan informasi tetapi akan mempertahankannya. regulator terpaksa menghubungi dokter untuk meminta maaf untuk pengungkapan. Beberapa dokter sebelumnya tidak menyadari keluhan tentang mereka, karena bukti tidak memenuhi ambang batas untuk memulai penyelidikan. Banyak dokter yang terlibat dalam Pro- Palestina sejak dimulainya perang genosida Israe
articles.originalTitle: Exclusive: UK doctors accused of antisemitism seek legal action against regulator over personal data leak
articles.originalDescription: Exclusive: UK doctors accused of antisemitism seek legal action against regulator over personal data leak Submitted by Amara Sophia Elahi on Fri, 11/20/2026 - 14:08 Doctors complained about over pro-Palestine posts fear for their safety after General Medical Council leaked data to national newspaper Pro-Palestine healthcare workers and protesters gather in London’s Parliament Square in solidarity with medical workers facing suspension over social media posts, on 15 October 2025 (Vuk Valcic/ZUMA Press Wire/Reuters) Off Doctors in the UK who have been referred to the General Medical Council (GMC) for alleged antisemitism and Islamophobia are considering legal action after the regulator leaked sensitive data about them to The Times newspaper, Middle East Eye has learned. The leak occurred following a Freedom of Information request submitted by the Times to the GMC, which asked for the number of doctors who had been complained about, investigated and sanctioned for antisemitism and Islamophobia since October 2023. In its response, the GMC shared the reference numbers of 223 doctors, which allows them to be identified through the regulator’s public-facing database. The GMC also included details of doctors’ ethnicities, which under UK law is a protected characteristic. In a letter sent to doctors' groups this week, Claire Light, the GMC’s head of equality, diversity and inclusion, stated that internal data had been shared with The Times “in error”, and that the regulator had formally requested through their lawyers that the newspaper deletes the confidential data and does not disseminate it. The Times has told the GMC that it will not publish the information but will retain it. The regulator was forced to contact doctors affected to apologise for the disclosure. Some doctors were not previously aware of complaints about them, because the evidence did not meet the threshold for initiating an investigation. articles.title: Koalisi meluncurkan operasi militer besar untuk menetralisir ancaman Houthi terhadap Arab Saudi
articles.description: RIYADH - Komando Pasukan Gabungan Koalisi untuk mengembalikan Legitimasi di Yaman diluncurkan pada hari Jumat sebuah operasi militer untuk menetralisir sumber ancaman yang digunakan oleh milisi teroris Houthi untuk menargetkan warga sipil di Arab Saudi dan Yaman, termasuk fasilitas penting yang mendukung kegiatan militernya. Koalisi mengatakan operasi ini menargetkan kemampuan militer Houthi dan infrastruktur yang terlibat dalam penyelundupan senjata dan transportasi, menambahkan operasi yang terus berlanjut terhadap target militer di pemerintahan Sanaa, Saada dan Taiz. Koalisi mengumumkan penghancuran tujuh target militer sah yang telah ditunjuk untuk penggunaan militer dan mendukung kegiatan militer Houthis '. Ini juga menegaskan penghancuran enam lokakarya yang digunakan oleh milisi untuk mendukung kemampuan militernya. Koalisi mengatakan operasinya di Sanaa difokuskan untuk menghancurkan dan menetralkan sumber ancaman untuk mencegah serangan terhadap warga sipil di Arab Saudi dan Yaman. Ini juga mengumumkan netralisasi dari salah satu milisi teroris Houthi fasilitas pasokan utama di Sanaa. Komando Pasukan Gabungan sebelumnya telah memanggil warga sipil untuk mengevakuasi pelabuhan Hodeidah sesuai dengan peta yang menyertai untuk memastikan keselamatan mereka.
articles.originalTitle: Coalition launches major military operation to neutralize Houthi threats against Saudi Arabia
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Joint Forces Command of the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen launched on Friday a military operation to neutralize sources of threat used by the Houthi terrorist militia to target civilians in Saudi Arabia and Yemen, including vital facilities supporting its military activities.The coalition said the operation targeted Houthi military capabilities and infrastructure involved in weapons smuggling and transportation, adding that operations were continuing against military targets in the governorates of Sanaa, Saada and Taiz.The coalition announced the destruction of seven legitimate military targets that had been designated for military use and supporting the Houthis’ military activities.It also confirmed the destruction of six workshops used by the militia to support its military capabilities.The coalition said its operations in Sanaa focused on destroying and neutralizing sources of threat to prevent attacks against civilians in Saudi Arabia and Yemen.It also announced the neutralization of one of the Houthi terrorist militia’s main supply facilities in Sanaa.The Joint Forces Command had earlier called on civilians to evacuate the port of Hodeidah in accordance with an accompanying map to ensure their safety.

UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband announced the sanctions on Tuesday, shortly before the Israeli government was scheduled to allocate tenders for the E1 settlement bloc, which would effectively split the occupied West Bank in two. Israeli officials insisted the decision was not in response to the sanctions. The sanctions target eight Israeli construction, property development and architectural firms. The UK also sanctioned Tsav9, an Israeli group involved in blocking aid deliveries into Gaza . The United States sanctioned the group in 2024. articles.originalDescription: Israeli experts warn Myanmar genocide ruling could strengthen Gaza case at ICJ Submitted by Nadav Rapaport on Fri, 11/20/2026 - 12:48 Israeli officials and legal experts fear the International Court of Justice's landmark ruling could influence its eventual judgment on South Africa's genocide case against Israel Displaced Palestinians living in tents set up among the rubble of their destroyed homes in Jabalia, northern Gaza Strip (Salah Hashem/ZUMA Press Wire via Reuters) Off Thursday's landmark ruling by the International Court of Justice (ICJ), holding Myanmar responsible for genocide against its Rohingya minority, has raised alarm among Israeli officials and legal experts over its potential implications for the genocide case against Israel over Gaza. "This is a dangerous precedent," a senior Israeli official told Ynet , referring to the ruling, which marked the first time the ICJ had found a state responsible for committing genocide. "This sets parameters and standards that, admittedly, you can't apply one-to-one to Israel, but it opens the door," the official added. While Israel's case in Gaza is "more complicated", the ruling "certainly doesn't do us any good". Another Israeli official told the public broadcaster Kan 11 that the decision reflected "worrying trends" at the top UN court, but insisted Israel could avoid a similar ruling in the case brought by South Africa in December 2023. The official said Israel could withstand "any legal test", insisting that "we did not commit a genocide". They estimated that a final judgment in the Gaza genocide case would not be delivered before 2030. articles.title: ZATCA foils enam upaya menyelundupkan lebih dari 2,3 juta pil amfetamin melalui Duba Port
articles.description: RIYADH - otoritas adat Saudi di Duba Port telah menggagalkan enam upaya menyelundupkan lebih dari 2.3 juta pil amfetamin tersembunyi dalam pengiriman tiba di Kingdom melalui pelabuhan. Hamoud Al- Harbi, juru bicara untuk badan amal, pajak dan Bea Cukai (ZATCA), mengatakan enam truk tiba di Kerajaan melalui Duba Port membawa pengiriman batu bata beton. Narkotika ditemukan tersembunyi di dalam rongga berongga batu bata selama pemeriksaan bea cukai menggunakan teknologi keamanan canggih dan anjing deteksi. Al- Harbi mengatakan bahwa setelah kejang, otoritas berkoordinasi dengan Direktorat Umum Kontrol Narkotika (GDNC) untuk menangkap penerima yang dimaksud dari narkotika di dalam Kerajaan, menghasilkan penahanannya. Dia menegaskan kembali komitmen ZATCA untuk memperketat bea cukai atas impor dan ekspor Kingdom di semua pelabuhan bea cukai dan memerangi upaya penyelundupan. Al- Harbi menekankan bahwa upaya ini sejalan dengan salah satu tujuan strategis otoritas dari meningkatkan keamanan dan melindungi masyarakat dengan mencegah penyelundupan narkotika dan zat terlarang lainnya. Dia menambahkan bahwa otoritas terus melaksanakan tugasnya dalam koordinasi dekat dan kerjasama dengan mitra di Kementerian Dalam Negeri dan Direktorat Umum Kontrol Narkotika.
articles.originalTitle: ZATCA foils six attempts to smuggle over 2.3 million amphetamine pills through Duba Port
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi customs authorities at Duba Port have foiled six attempts to smuggle more than 2.3 million amphetamine pills concealed in shipments arriving in the Kingdom through the port.Hamoud Al-Harbi, spokesperson for the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA), said six trucks arrived in the Kingdom through Duba Port carrying shipments of concrete bricks.The narcotics were discovered concealed inside the hollow cavities of the bricks during customs inspections using advanced security technologies and detection dogs.Al-Harbi said that following the seizures, the authority coordinated with the General Directorate of Narcotics Control (GDNC) to apprehend the intended recipient of the narcotics inside the Kingdom, resulting in his arrest.He reaffirmed ZATCA's commitment to tightening customs controls over the Kingdom's imports and exports across all customs ports and combating smuggling attempts.Al-Harbi emphasized that these efforts are in line with one of the authority's key strategic objectives of enhancing security and protecting society by preventing the smuggling of narcotics and other prohibited substances.He added that the authority continues to carry out its duties in close coordination and cooperation with its partners at the Ministry of Interior and the General Directorate of Narcotics Control.

articles.title: Pasukan Israel menahan tahanan yang baru-baru ini dibebaskan dalam penggerebekan Bank Barat
articles.description: Pasukan Israel menahan tahanan baru-baru ini di serangan Bank Barat pasukan Israel telah menyerbu rumah-rumah dan menangkap beberapa warga Palestina, termasuk baru-baru ini membebaskan tahanan, di seluruh Tepi Barat yang diduduki, menurut agen berita Palestina Wafa. Saat fajar, tentara menangkap Muadh Nader Sawafta, 23, di desa Tubas, dan Naji Ibrahim Bisharat, 50, di kota terdekat Tammun, selatan Tubas. Kamal Bani Odeh, direktur Lembaga Tahanan Palestina di Tubas, mengatakan bahwa Sawafta telah dibebaskan dari penahanan Israel dua bulan lalu. Pasukan Israel telah menahan 20 orang muda dari dua desa pada malam sebelumnya, kebanyakan dari mereka dari Tubas, sebelum melepaskan mereka, laporan mengatakan. Dalam serangan terpisah pada hari Jumat, pasukan Israel menangkap tiga orang Palestina di Qarawa Bani Hassan, barat daya Nablus. Salah satunya adalah mantan tahanan yang dibebaskan hanya dua hari sebelumnya setelah menghabiskan dua tahun di penjara Israel, menurut Wafa. Sebelumnya pada hari Jumat, tentara menyerbu rumah-rumah di lingkungan Iktaba, timur Tulkarem, dan menangkap tiga orang Palestina. Sumber lokal mengidentifikasi salah satu dari mereka sebagai Jihad-Qazli, mantan tahanan dari kamp pengungsi Nur Shams. Pasukan Israel mengusir pemilik tanah Palestina dan aktivis Israel mencoba menanam pohon zaitun di Idna, utara Hebron, menduduki Tepi Barat, 18 November 2026 (Hazem Bader / AFP)
articles.originalTitle: Israeli forces detain recently released prisoners in West Bank raids
articles.originalDescription: Israeli forces detain recently released prisoners in West Bank raids Israeli forces have raided homes and arrested several Palestinians, including recently released prisoners, across the occupied West Bank, according to the Palestinian news agency Wafa. At dawn, soldiers arrested Muadh Nader Sawafta, 23, in the village of Tubas, and Naji Ibrahim Bisharat, 50, in the nearby town of Tammun, south of Tubas. Kamal Bani Odeh, director of the Palestinian Prisoners Society in Tubas, said that Sawafta had been released from Israeli detention two months ago. Israeli forces had detained 20 young men from the two villages the previous night, most of them from Tubas, before releasing them, the report said. In a separate raid on Friday, Israeli forces arrested three Palestinians in Qarawa Bani Hassan, southwest of Nablus. One of them was a former prisoner who had been released just two days earlier after spending two years in Israeli prisons, according to Wafa. Earlier on Friday, soldiers raided homes in the Iktaba neighbourhood, east of Tulkarem, and arrested three Palestinians. Local sources identified one of them as Jihad al-Qazli, a former prisoner from Nur Shams refugee camp. Israeli forces drive away Palestinian landowners and Israeli activists attempting to plant olive trees in Idna, north of Hebron, occupied West Bank, 18 November 2026 (Hazem Bader/AFP)

articles.title: Jepang berencana menawarkan Arab Saudi 16 juta barel penyimpanan minyak tambahan, membeli hingga 8 juta barel
articles.description: RIYADH - Jepang bermaksud untuk menyediakan Arab Saudi dengan tambahan 16 juta barel kapasitas penyimpanan minyak mentah dan membeli hingga 8 juta barel Saudi mentah untuk cadangan nasional, Saudi Pers Agency melaporkan pada hari Jumat. Pengumuman ini datang setelah pertemuan virtual antara Menteri Energi Saudi dan Menteri Industri dan Mineral Resource Prince Abdullah bin Salman dan Menteri Ekonomi Jepang, Perdagangan dan Industri Ryoseti Akazawa pada Nov 9, 2026. Selama pertemuan, dua menteri menegaskan kembali kemitraan strategis yang kuat dan berlangsung lama antara Arab Saudi dan Jepang dan mendiskusikan cara untuk memperkuat kerjasama bilateral, terutama di sektor energi. Setelah diskusi dalam satuan tugas gabungan didirikan pada Mei 2026, Arab Saudi menegaskan kembali bahwa hal itu menyangkut Jepang sebagai mitra strategis dan menempel sangat penting untuk mendukung jangka panjang energi keamanan melalui stabil dan dapat diandalkan pasokan minyak mentah. Jepang menyatakan apresiasi yang mendalam kepada Arab Saudi untuk penyediaan yang stabil dan dapat diandalkan pasokan minyak mentah. Kerajaan sudah mulai mengisi ulang minyaknya di Jepang. Mengenali pentingnya lama dari Proyek Penimbunan Minyak Kaus Gabungan, didirikan pada tahun 2010, dan yang baru-baru ini menunjukkan efektivitas, Jepang bermaksud untuk membuat tambahan 16 juta barel kapasitas minyak mentah tersedia ke Arab Saudi untuk jangka waktu terbatas melalui fasilitas penimbunan nasional. Kapasitas tambahan akan membawa total kapasitas penyimpanan yang tersedia untuk Kerajaan di bawah pengaturan untuk 24 juta barel, termasuk kapasitas yang ada 8 juta barel. Jepang juga berniat untuk membeli hingga 8 juta barel minyak mentah Saudi untuk cadangan stockpile nasional, subjek kondisi pasar yang menguntungkan dan penyelesaian prosedur internal yang diperlukan. Kedua negara ini juga akan bekerja sama di bawah inisiatif "POWERR Asia" Jepang untuk meningkatkan keamanan energi di seluruh Asia, membangun Program
articles.originalTitle: Japan plans to offer Saudi Arabia 16 million barrels of additional oil storage, buy up to 8 million barrels
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Japan intends to provide Saudi Arabia with an additional 16 million barrels of crude oil storage capacity and purchase up to 8 million barrels of Saudi crude for its national reserves, Saudi Press Agency reported on Friday.The announcement came following a virtual meeting between Saudi Minister of Energy and Minister of Industry and Mineral Resources Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman and Japanese Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry Ryosei Akazawa on Nov. 9, 2026.During the meeting, the two ministers reaffirmed the strong and longstanding strategic partnership between Saudi Arabia and Japan and discussed ways to further strengthen bilateral cooperation, particularly in the energy sector.Following discussions within the joint task force established in May 2026, Saudi Arabia reaffirmed that it regards Japan as a strategic partner and attaches great importance to supporting its long-term energy security through stable and reliable crude oil supplies.Japan expressed its deep appreciation to Saudi Arabia for its continued provision of stable and reliable crude oil supplies.The Kingdom has already begun replenishing joint oil stockpiling tanks in Japan.Recognizing the longstanding importance of the Joint Crude Oil Stockpiling Project, established in 2010, and its recently demonstrated effectiveness, Japan intends to make an additional 16 million barrels of crude oil storage capacity available to Saudi Arabia for a limited period through its national stockpiling facilities.The additional capacity would bring the total storage capacity available to the Kingdom under the arrangement to 24 million barrels, including the existing capacity of 8 million barrels.Japan also intends to purchase up to 8 million barrels of Saudi crude oil for its national stockpile reserves, subject to favorable market conditions and the completion of necessary internal procedures.The two countries will also cooperate under Japan's "POWERR Asia" initiative to enhance energy security across Asia

articles.title: Arab Saudi berhak mempertahankan wilayahnya, rakyat dan kepentingan nasional:
articles.description: NAPLES - Wakil Menteri Luar Negeri Saudi Waleed Al- Khuraiji menegaskan kembali bahwa Kerajaan berhak untuk mempertahankan wilayahnya, rakyat dan kepentingan nasional sesuai dengan hukum internasional. Kata-katanya datang selama sesi berjudul "Mengamankan Strategic Chokepoints dan memikirkan ulang Keamanan Maritime" pada hari Kamis, diadakan di sela-sela dialog Mediterania (MED) konferensi di Naples, Italia. Al- Khuraiji mengatakan perkembangan terbaru di koridor maritim mendasari keterhubungan dekat antara keamanan maritim, stabilitas regional dan kemakmuran global. Dia mencatat bahwa keamanan saluran air strategis, dari Laut Merah dan Bab Al- Mandab Selat ke Selat Hormuz, adalah masalah perhatian internasional. Dia menekankan bahwa melindungi koridor maritim strategis tetap menjadi prioritas fundamental yang membutuhkan efektif regional dan kerjasama internasional. Wakil menteri menekankan pentingnya fokus pada upaya diplomatik, de- eskalasi dan menangani akar penyebab ketidakstabilan daerah untuk memastikan bahwa jalur air penting tetap aman dan terbuka sesuai dengan hukum internasional. Di Yaman, Al- Khuraiji menegaskan kembali Saudi Arabia terus berkomitmen untuk mencapai keamanan dan kemakmuran di negara ini. Dia juga menekankan pentingnya menghadapi segala upaya untuk menggunakan wilayah Yaman untuk mengancam negara-negara tetangga atau navigasi internasional.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia reserves legitimate right to defend its territory, people and national interests: Al-Khuraiji
articles.originalDescription: NAPLES — Saudi Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs Waleed Al-Khuraiji reaffirmed that the Kingdom reserves its legitimate right to defend its territory, people and national interests in accordance with international law.His remarks came during a session titled "Securing Strategic Chokepoints and Rethinking Maritime Security" on Thursday, held on the sidelines of the Mediterranean Dialogues (MED) conference in Naples, Italy.Al-Khuraiji said recent developments in maritime corridors underscore the close interconnectedness between maritime security, regional stability and global prosperity.He noted that the security of strategic waterways, from the Red Sea and Bab Al-Mandab Strait to the Strait of Hormuz, is a matter of international concern.He emphasized that protecting strategic maritime corridors remains a fundamental priority that requires effective regional and international cooperation.The deputy minister stressed the importance of focusing on diplomatic efforts, de-escalation and addressing the root causes of regional instability to ensure that vital waterways remain safe and open in accordance with international law.On Yemen, Al-Khuraiji reaffirmed Saudi Arabia's continued commitment to achieving security and prosperity in the country.He also stressed the importance of confronting any attempts to use Yemeni territory to threaten neighboring countries or international navigation.

articles.title: Arab Saudi memperingatkan terhadap eksploitasi sumber daya alam untuk membiayai kekerasan dan konflik perpanjang
articles.description: NEW YORK - Arab Saudi telah memperingatkan terhadap eksploitasi sumber daya alam untuk membiayai kekerasan dan konflik memperpanjang, menyerukan intensifed kerjasama internasional untuk memerangi perdagangan terlarang dalam sumber daya dan melindungi fasilitas energi, koridor maritim dan rantai pasokan. Pernyataan tersebut dibuat oleh Chargé d 'Affaires dari Saudi Arabia' s Permanent Mission kepada PBB di New York Fares Al- Otaibi selama sesi Dewan Keamanan PBB pada sumber daya alam dan konflik. Arab Saudi menekankan pentingnya menghormati kedaulatan negara-negara atas sumber daya alam mereka dan memperkuat transparansi dan akuntabilitas untuk memastikan bahwa pendapatan mereka menguntungkan rakyat mereka. The Kingdom menunjukkan bahwa serangan Houthi terhadap fasilitas minyak telah mengganggu ekspor Yaman dan kekurangan rakyat Yaman sumber daya ekonomi penting. Arab Saudi juga menyoroti usahanya di bawah Saudi Vision 2030 untuk mempromosikan pengelolaan sumber daya berkelanjutan dan diversifikasi ekonomi. Kerajaan menekankan pentingnya kemitraan internasional dalam menangani akar penyebab konflik dan mempromosikan stabilitas.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia warns against exploitation of natural resources to finance violence and prolong conflicts
articles.originalDescription: NEW YORK — Saudi Arabia has warned against the exploitation of natural resources to finance violence and prolong conflicts, calling for intensified international cooperation to combat illicit trade in these resources and protect energy facilities, maritime corridors and supply chains.The remarks were made by Acting Chargé d'Affaires of Saudi Arabia's Permanent Mission to the United Nations in New York Fares Al-Otaibi during a UN Security Council session on natural resources and conflicts.Saudi Arabia stressed the importance of respecting countries' sovereignty over their natural resources and strengthening transparency and accountability to ensure that their revenues benefit their people.The Kingdom pointed out that Houthi attacks on oil facilities have disrupted Yemen's exports and deprived the Yemeni people of vital economic resources.Saudi Arabia also highlighted its efforts under Saudi Vision 2030 to promote sustainable resource management and economic diversification.The Kingdom emphasized the importance of international partnerships in addressing the root causes of conflicts and promoting stability.

articles.title: Tingkat Riyadh pertama secara global dalam Indeks Layanan Daring Lokal PBB dengan skor sempurna
articles.description: RIYADH - Riyadh telah peringkat pertama secara global di United Nations Online Services Index (LOSI) dalam laporan PBB 2026, yang menilai kota di seluruh 194 negara. Ibukota Saudi mencapai nilai sempurna 100% di semua kategori penilaian, maju dari tempat ketiga di 2024 peringkat. Riyadh Municipality berkontribusi untuk prestasi ini dengan memajukan layanan digital di enam area kunci indeks: layanan digital, konten digital, kerangka institusi, literasi digital, infrastruktur dan partisipasi digital. Pemimpin global Riyadh dalam indeks juga mencerminkan kemajuan yang dicapai di bawah Program Transformasi Riyadh Municipal, yang bertujuan untuk memberikan transformasi digital komprehensif melalui layanan tinggi-kualitas, resident-sentris. Program ini berusaha meningkatkan kualitas hidup warga melalui layanan cerdas canggih yang memenuhi kebutuhan dan aspirasi sehari-hari mereka, lebih lanjut memposisikan posisi Riyadh di antara kota-kota terkemuka di pemerintahan digital.
articles.originalTitle: Riyadh ranks first globally in UN Local Online Services Index with perfect score
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Riyadh has ranked first globally in the United Nations Local Online Services Index (LOSI) in the 2026 UN report, which assessed cities across 194 countries.The Saudi capital achieved a perfect score of 100% across all assessment categories, advancing from third place in the 2024 rankings.Riyadh Municipality contributed to this achievement by advancing its digital services across the index's six key areas: digital services, digital content, institutional framework, digital literacy, infrastructure and digital participation.Riyadh's global leadership in the index also reflects the progress achieved under the Riyadh Municipal Transformation Program, which aims to deliver comprehensive digital transformation through high-quality, resident-centric services.The program seeks to enhance residents' quality of life through advanced smart services that meet their daily needs and aspirations, further cementing Riyadh's position among the world's leading cities in digital governance.
