articles.title: Pro- pemukim grafiti ditemukan di masjid ditargetkan dalam serangan pembakaran di Israel
articles.description: Pro- pemukim grafiti ditemukan di masjid yang ditargetkan dalam serangan pembakaran di Israel Sebuah masjid di desa Dahi di utara Israel dibakar dalam suatu malam pembakaran, dengan grafiti Ibrani di dinding terdekat menuntut balas dendam untuk kematian pemukim Bank Barat, polisi Israel mengatakan. Graffiti itu mengacu pada Yehuda Sherman, seorang pemukim tewas pada bulan Maret setelah ditabrak mobil yang dikendarai oleh orang Palestina, menurut The Times of Israel. Rekaman kamera keamanan yang diterbitkan oleh media Israel menunjukkan tiga orang mendekati gedung dengan wadah sebelum melarikan diri. Badan keamanan Shin Bet telah bergabung dengan penyelidikan, Haaretz melaporkan, menambahkan bahwa Polisi sedang menyelidiki kebakaran dan mencari tersangka. Imam masjid, Sheikh Khalad Zuabi, mengatakan pada Ynet bahwa para pemuja menemukan api ketika mereka tiba untuk doa pagi.
articles.originalTitle: Pro-settler graffiti found at mosque targeted in arson attack in Israel
articles.originalDescription: Pro-settler graffiti found at mosque targeted in arson attack in Israel A mosque in the village of Dahi in northern Israel was set on fire in an arson attack overnight, with Hebrew graffiti on nearby walls demanding revenge for the death of a West Bank settler, Israeli police said. The graffiti referred to Yehuda Sherman, a settler killed in March after being struck by a car driven by a Palestinian, according to The Times of Israel. Security camera footage published by Israeli media appeared to show three people approaching the building with a container before fleeing. The Shin Bet security agency has joined the investigation, Haaretz reported, adding that Police were investigating the fire and searching for suspects. The mosque’s imam, Sheikh Khalad Zuabi, told Ynet that worshippers discovered the fire when they arrived for morning prayers.

articles.title: Serangan udara menyerang gudang dan pabrik di Yaman Sanaa, pihak berwenang Houthi mengatakan
articles.description: Serangan udara ke gudang-gudang dan pabrik-pabrik di Yaman Sanaa, pihak berwenang Houthi mengatakan serangkaian serangan udara berat menghantam ibukota Yaman, Sanaa, dengan otoritas Houthi melaporkan kerusakan ke gudang penyimpanan makanan, gudang dan pabrik milik Perusahaan Air Mineral Yaman Saudi, Al Jazeera melaporkan. Serangan itu diikuti klaim oleh juru bicara militer Houthis 'bahwa kelompok telah dilakukan empat operasi di dalam Arab Saudi, menargetkan bandara Raja Khalid, pusat keuangan dan perusahaan petrokimia di Riyadh, serta Khamis Mushait pangkalan udara. Juru bicara mengatakan serangan itu adalah pembalasan atas serangan udara pada perahu membawa orang-orang yang mengungsi di pelabuhan Ras Al- Ara di Yaman Selatan. Dia mengatakan 19 dari 25 orang kapal tewas dan empat terluka, dengan tubuh mereka tersebar di pantai. Sebuah pemandangan umum menunjukkan kerusakan di pabrik alas kaki berikut dugaan serangan udara Saudi di lingkungan Sanaa-Nahda, 17 November 2026 (Mohammed Huwais / AFP)
articles.originalTitle: Air strikes hit warehouses and factory in Yemen’s Sanaa, Houthi authorities say
articles.originalDescription: Air strikes hit warehouses and factory in Yemen’s Sanaa, Houthi authorities say A series of heavy air strikes hit Yemen’s capital, Sanaa, with Houthi authorities reporting damage to a food storage warehouse, a warehouse and a factory belonging to the Yemeni-Saudi Mineral Water Company, Al Jazeera reported. The attacks followed claims by the Houthis’ military spokesman that the group had carried out four operations deep inside Saudi Arabia, targeting King Khalid airport, a financial centre and a petrochemicals company in Riyadh, as well as Khamis Mushait airbase. The spokesperson said the attacks were in retaliation for an air strike on a boat carrying displaced people at the port of Ras al-Ara in southern Yemen. He said 19 of the 25 people aboard were killed and four were wounded, with their bodies scattered along the coast. A general view shows damage at a footwear factory following an alleged Saudi airstrike in Sanaa’s al-Nahda neighbourhood, 17 November 2026 (Mohammed Huwais/AFP)

articles.title: Kementerian Gaza menuntut pembebasan direktur rumah sakit yang ditahan dan 81 pekerja kesehatan
articles.description: Menteri Gaza menuntut pembebasan direktur rumah sakit yang ditahan dan 81 pekerja kesehatan Departemen Kesehatan Gaza telah mengkritik keputusan Israel untuk memperpanjang penahanan Dr Hussam Abu Safila, direktur Rumah Sakit Kamal Adwan, dengan enam bulan lainnya tanpa biaya atau percobaan, menggambarkan itu sebagai "kejahatan senyawa". Dalam sebuah pernyataan, menteri mengatakan penahanan Abu SaSofia terus melanggar hukum internasional, termasuk Konvensi Jenewa, yang memberikan perlindungan bagi para pekerja medis dan kemanusiaan. Dikatakan 81 pekerja kesehatan Palestina tetap dalam penahanan Israel, di mana mereka menghadapi penyiksaan fisik dan psikologis, penyangkalan perwakilan hukum dan kelalaian medis. Sebuah pengadilan Israel di Beersheba memperpanjang penahanan Abu SaSofia pada hari Rabu, menolak permintaan pengacaranya untuk dibebaskan. Dia ditahan selama serangan Israel di Rumah Sakit Kamal Adwan pada Desember 2024. Kantor HAM PBB mengatakan menerima informasi bahwa dia mengalami penyiksaan, kurungan yang berkepanjangan dan penyangkalan terhadap perawatan medis.
articles.originalTitle: Gaza ministry demands release of detained hospital director and 81 health workers
articles.originalDescription: Gaza ministry demands release of detained hospital director and 81 health workers Gaza’s health ministry has criticised Israel’s decision to extend the detention of Dr Hussam Abu Safia, director of Kamal Adwan Hospital, by another six months without charge or trial, describing it as a “compound crime”. In a statement, the ministry said Abu Safia’s continued detention violated international law, including the Geneva Conventions, which provide protections for medical and humanitarian workers. It said 81 Palestinian health workers remained in Israeli detention, where they faced physical and psychological torture, denial of legal representation and medical neglect. An Israeli court in Beersheba extended Abu Safia’s detention on Wednesday, rejecting his lawyer’s request for his release. He was detained during an Israeli raid on Kamal Adwan Hospital in December 2024. The UN human rights office has said it received information that he was subjected to torture, prolonged solitary confinement and denial of medical care.

articles.title: Menteri Pendidikan Saudi menandatangani 9 perjanjian kerja sama dengan universitas dan perusahaan AS
articles.description: WASHINGTON - Saudi Menteri Pendidikan Yousef bin Abdullah Al- Benyan menyaksikan penandatanganan perjanjian kerjasama bilateral antara entitas pendidikan Saudi dan universitas Amerika dan perusahaan selama kunjungan resminya ke Amerika Serikat. Perjanjian tersebut berfokus pada teknologi pendidikan, kandungan kurikulum dan digital, bertujuan untuk mengembangkan alat-alat pendidikan dan sumber daya, memanfaatkan keahlian internasional dan meningkatkan kualitas pendidikan dan pembelajaran. * * media [2797132] * * Perjanjian tersebut termasuk kerjasama antara Dewan Persatuan Urusan dan Universitas Galladet, yang mengkhususkan diri dalam mendidik siswa dengan gangguan pendengaran, untuk mengembangkan program akademik dan khusus, memajukan penelitian ilmiah dan studi bersama, personil kereta api dan keahlian pertukaran. Al- Benyan juga menyaksikan perjanjian antara Princess Nourah Bint University Abdulrahman dan Layanan Pengujian Pendidikan (ETS), Maarif untuk Pendidikan dan Google, dan Maarif untuk Pendidikan dan National Geographic. Kesepakatan lain ditandatangani antara Perusahaan Teknologi Pendidikan Tatweer (TETCO) dan Google dan Cisco, sementara Perusahaan Pendidikan Tatweer menandatangani perjanjian dengan Savvas, McGraw Hill dan National Geographic untuk mengembangkan kurikulum dan konten pendidikan. * * media [2797133] * * Rekanan-rekanan ini mencakup pendidikan khusus, penilaian dan evaluasi, integrasi teknologi modern ke dalam pendidikan, dan pengembangan solusi digital dan sumber daya pendidikan untuk memperkaya kurikulum dan meningkatkan pengalaman belajar. Mereka juga bertujuan untuk memanfaatkan keahlian internasional dalam mengembangkan alat-alat pendidikan, platform, dan sumber daya sambil memperkuat kerjasama teknologi dan pendidikan antara lembaga-lembaga Saudi dan mitra global. Perjanjian mendukung upaya Kementerian Pendidikan untuk mempercepat transformasi digital, memajukan kurikulum dan konten pendidikan, dan memperluas penggunaan teknologi dan ino
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Education Minister witnesses signing of 9 cooperation agreements with US universities and companies
articles.originalDescription: WASHINGTON — Saudi Minister of Education Yousef bin Abdullah Al-Benyan witnessed the signing of nine bilateral cooperation agreements between Saudi educational entities and American universities, institutions and companies during his official visit to the United States. The agreements focus on educational technologies, curricula and digital content, aiming to develop educational tools and resources, leverage international expertise and improve the quality of education and learning outcomes. **media[2797132]** The agreements include cooperation between the Council of Universities' Affairs and Gallaudet University, which specializes in educating students with hearing disabilities, to develop academic and specialized programs, advance scientific research and joint studies, train personnel and exchange expertise. Al-Benyan also witnessed agreements between Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University and Educational Testing Service (ETS), Maarif for Education and Google, and Maarif for Education and National Geographic. Another agreement was signed between Tatweer Educational Technologies Company (TETCO) and Google and Cisco, while Tatweer Education Company signed agreements with Savvas, McGraw Hill and National Geographic to develop curricula and educational content. **media[2797133]** The partnerships cover specialized education, assessment and evaluation, the integration of modern technologies into education, and the development of digital solutions and educational resources to enrich curricula and improve the learning experience. They also aim to leverage international expertise in developing educational tools, platforms and resources while strengthening technological and educational cooperation between Saudi institutions and global partners. The agreements support the Ministry of Education's efforts to accelerate digital transformation, advance curricula and educational content, and expand the use of modern technologies and innovation to improve educational practice

articles.title: Update pagi
articles.description: Pagi pembaruan Selamat pagi pembaca Mata Timur Tengah, Berikut adalah perkembangan terbaru: Koalisi Saudi- dipimpin mengatakan dalam pernyataan terpisah bahwa hal itu dicegat dan menghancurkan drone dan rudal diluncurkan oleh Houthis Yaman menuju Arab Saudi selama beberapa jam terakhir, termasuk yang menargetkan daerah selatan Kingem dan ibukota Riyadh. Lebih dari 115 serangan yang diklaim oleh Iran atau kelompok yang bersekutu dengan Teheran telah merusak 26 pangkalan militer dan infrastruktur lainnya milik AS di Timur Tengah, The Associated Press melaporkan. Analisisnya, menggunakan citra satelit, menunjukkan bahwa serangan Iran terhadap situs-situs AS di wilayah tersebut sebagian besar menargetkan sistem peringatan awal, pesawat dan bangunan, menghasilkan kerusakan senilai miliaran dolar pada peralatan AS. Seorang pejabat Pentagon mengatakan kepada penegak hukum bahwa perang AS terhadap Iran telah biaya diperkirakan $48.3 miliar. "Angka itu termasuk amunisi, biaya penggantian peralatan, dan biaya operasional", kata Arthur Miller. Namun, angka tidak termasuk harga perbaikan instalasi militer AS di wilayah rusak sejak Februari. Duta Besar Israel kepada Yechiel Leiter AS berkata pada hari Kamis bahwa keputusan untuk memperbarui serangan terhadap Iran "akan diambil oleh Presiden Trump". Berbicara dengan media AS Newsmax, Leiter berkata Israel akan mendukung AS jika Trump memutuskan untuk menyerang Iran.
articles.originalTitle: Morning update
articles.originalDescription: Morning update Good morning Middle East Eye readers, Here are the latest developments: The Saudi-led coalition said in separate statements that it intercepted and destroyed drones and a missile launched by Yemen's Houthis towards Saudi Arabia over the past few hours, including ones targeting the kingom's southern region and its capital of Riyadh. Over 115 strikes claimed by Iran or groups aligned with Tehran have damaged 26 military bases and other infrastructure belonging to the US across the Middle East, The Associated Press reported. The analysis, using satellite imagery, indicated that Iranian attacks on US sites in the region have mostly targeted early-warning systems, aircraft and buildings, resulting in billions of dollars’ worth of damage to US equipment. A Pentagon official told lawmakers that the US war on Iran has cost an estimated $48.3 billion. "That number includes munitions, equipment replacement costs, and operational cost," Arthur Miller said. However, the figure does not include the price of repairing US military installations in the region damaged since February. Israel’s Ambassador to the US Yechiel Leiter said on Thursday that the decision to renew strikes against Iran “will be taken by President Trump”. Speaking to US media outlet Newsmax, Leiter said Israel will support the US if Trump decides to attack Iran.

articles.title: Koalisi mencegat lima pesawat tak berawak, satu rudal balistik saat isu pertahanan sipil memperingatkan di Asir, Jazan
articles.description: RIYADH - Koalisi untuk menyokong Legitimasi di Yaman mengumumkan bahwa lima pesawat tak berawak dan satu rudal balistik yang diluncurkan oleh teroris milisi Houthi telah dicegat dan dihancurkan pada hari Jumat, ketika pertahanan sipil mengeluarkan peringatan darurat di bagian daerah Asir dan Jazan. Jumaat pagi, Juru bicara Koalisi, Mayor Jenderal Turki Al- Malki mengkonfirmasi kedatangan dan penghancuran pesawat tanpa awak yang diluncurkan oleh milisi Houthi menuju daerah Arab Saudi. Koalisi kemudian mengumumkan interception dan kehancuran dari drone lain diluncurkan ke arah daerah yang sama. Kemudian pagi itu, Al-Malki mengumumkan bahwa pertahanan udara telah dicegat dan menghancurkan rudal balistik diluncurkan ke arah daerah selatan. The Coalition kemudian dikonfirmasi interception dan kehancuran dari drone ketiga diluncurkan ke arah daerah yang sama. Dalam pengumuman terbaru, Koalisi mengkonfirmasi bahwa dua drone tambahan telah dicegat dan dihancurkan di Riyadh dan daerah selatan. Sementara itu, Direktorat Umum Pertahanan Sipil mengeluarkan peringatan melalui National Early Warning Plaform untuk darurat di kota Jazan, serta Abha dan Khamis Mushait di daerah Asir. Peringatan pertama diumumkan Jumat pagi di kota Jazan, diikuti dengan peringatan terpisah di Abha dan Khamis Mushait kemudian pagi itu, memperingatkan penduduk untuk potensi bahaya. Pertahanan sipil mendesak warga menerima peringatan darurat untuk tetap tenang, mengikuti instruksi resmi dan segera mencari tempat berlindung di lokasi yang aman terdekat, lebih baik di dalam gedung atau ruang interior jauh dari jendela. Pihak berwenang juga menyarankan warga untuk tetap di dalam rumah sampai bahaya telah berlalu, menghindari daerah terbuka dan berpotensi lokasi berbahaya, dan mengikuti petunjuk yang dikeluarkan melalui saluran resmi. Pertahanan sipil terus mendesak publik untuk melaporkan keadaan darurat dengan memanggil 911 di Mekah, Madinah, Riyadh dan Provinsi Timur, atau 998 di bagian lain dari Kerajaa
articles.originalTitle: Coalition intercepts five drones, one ballistic missile as Civil Defense issues alerts in Asir, Jazan
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen announced that five drones and one ballistic missile launched by the terrorist Houthi militia had been intercepted and destroyed on Friday, as Civil Defense issued emergency warnings in parts of the Asir and Jazan regions. Early Friday morning, Coalition spokesperson Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Malki confirmed the interception and destruction of a drone launched by the Houthi militia toward Saudi Arabia’s southern region. The Coalition subsequently announced the interception and destruction of another drone launched toward the same region. Later that morning, Al-Malki announced that air defenses had intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched toward the southern region. The Coalition then confirmed the interception and destruction of a third drone launched toward the same region. In its latest announcement, the Coalition confirmed that two additional drones had been intercepted and destroyed in the Riyadh and southern regions. Meanwhile, the General Directorate of Civil Defense issued warnings through the National Early Warning Platform for Emergencies in Jazan city, as well as Abha and Khamis Mushait in the Asir region. The first warning was announced early Friday morning in Jazan city, followed by separate warnings in Abha and Khamis Mushait later that morning, alerting residents to potential danger. Civil Defense urged residents receiving emergency alerts to remain calm, follow official instructions and immediately seek shelter in the nearest safe location, preferably inside a building or an interior room away from windows. The authority also advised residents to remain indoors until the danger had passed, avoid open areas and potentially dangerous locations, and follow instructions issued through official channels. Civil Defense further urged the public to report emergencies by calling 911 in Makkah, Madinah, Riyadh and the Eastern Province, or 998 in other parts of the Kingdom.

articles.title: Orange peringatan dikeluarkan untuk cuaca berat di Jazan, Mekah dan Asir sebagai badai terus badai Saudi Arab
articles.description: JEDDAH - Pusat Nasional Meteorologi (NCM) telah mengeluarkan peringatan oranye untuk curah hujan sedang di bagian Jazan, Mekah dan daerah Asir pada hari Jumat ketika badai dan hujan terus melewati beberapa bagian Arab Saudi. Peringatan oranye yang berlaku dari 5: 00 sampai 5: 00, dengan peringatan NCM angin kuat, dekat -nol visibilitas horizontal, hujan, banjir flash, gelombang tinggi dan petir. Menurut ramalan cuaca nasional NCM, menengah untuk badai petir berat disertai oleh angin aktif dan hujan es diharapkan untuk terus berlangsung di bagian-bagian Asir daerah, berpotensi memicu banjir kilat. Sementara itu, cahaya untuk moderat curah hujan diramalkan di bagian Jazan, Al- Baha dan daerah Mekah. Kabut juga mungkin terbentuk di bagian-bagian daerah ini, serta Provinsi Timur, sementara kondisi cuaca diharapkan untuk tetap stabil di seluruh Kerajaan.
articles.originalTitle: Orange alerts issued for heavy weather in Jazan, Makkah and Asir as thunderstorms continue across Saudi Arabia
articles.originalDescription: JEDDAH — The National Center for Meteorology (NCM) has issued orange alerts for moderate rainfall in parts of Jazan, Makkah and Asir regions on Friday as thunderstorms and rainfall continue across several parts of Saudi Arabia. The orange alerts are in effect from 5 a.m. to 5 p.m., with the NCM warning of strong winds, near-zero horizontal visibility, hail, flash floods, high waves and lightning. According to the NCM's nationwide weather forecast, moderate to heavy thunderstorms accompanied by active winds and hail are expected to continue across parts of Asir region, potentially triggering flash floods. Meanwhile, light to moderate rainfall is forecast across parts of Jazan, Al-Baha and Makkah regions. Fog may also form in parts of these regions, as well as the Eastern Province, while weather conditions are expected to remain stable across the rest of the Kingdom.

articles.originalTitle: The Gaza Podcast: Winning an Emmy while starving

articles.title: Kepercayaan diri di Hormuz telah 'hancur' oleh perang terhadap Iran, IEA mengatakan
articles.description: Kepercayaan diri di Hormuz telah dihancurkan oleh perang melawan Iran, IEA mengatakan diturunkan oleh staf MEE pada Thu, 11 / 19 / 2026 - 21: 17 Kepala Energi mengatakan dunia bisa 'mengelola tanpa Hormuz' tapi itu akan membutuhkan $240bn dalam investasi Sebuah anggota pemerintah Irak berjalan di samping pipa di Lapangan Minyak Bai Hassan, barat dari utara kota Irak Kirkuk, pada 19 Oktober 2017 (Ahmad all-baye / AFP) Off Perang AS-Israel di Iran telah "hancur" kepercayaan Selat Hormuz sebagai aliran air yang dapat diandalkan untuk ekspor energi, Fatih Biope, Badan Internasional (Organisasi Internasional) "Saya tidak melihat jalur kredibel untuk kembali ke situasi yang ada pada bulan Februari 2026", tulis Birol untuk majalah The Economist dalam esai diterbitkan pada hari Rabu. "Pengiriman mengalir melalui Selat Hormuz telah diblokir sekali, dengan efek sangat mengganggu di pasar minyak dan gas. Itu bisa terjadi lagi. Percaya diri dalam Selat sebagai aman dan dapat diandalkan koridor untuk energi dan barang-barang lain telah hancur," tambahnya. Birol mengatakan bahwa dunia "dapat dibayangkan mengelola tanpa selat", tapi itu akan "sulit". Dalam laporan World Energy Outlook yang diterbitkan pada hari Kamis, IEA mengatakan mengembangkan jaringan pipa alternatif di sekitar jalur air akan memerlukan sekitar $40bn. Ini akan menambahkan sekitar $2 dengan biaya laras minyak diekspor dari Timur Tengah. Tambahan $200bn perlu dibelanjakan untuk sumber energi alternatif di luar Timur Tengah. IEA mengatakan bahwa dalam kasus minyak saja, proyek pipa baru berada di bawah pembangunan atau pertimbangan di Timur Tengah yang dapat memompa sekitar tujuh juta barel per hari minyak, memungkinkan produsen untuk mencapai pasar internasional tanpa melalui selat. "Jika semua proyek ini selesai, produsen non-Gulf meningkatkan output, dan importir menurunkan permintaan, maka Kasus Hormuz Rendah kami mengurangi kebutuhan untuk transit melalui Selat 2 mbp pada tahun 2035", kata IEA, merangkum bag
articles.originalTitle: Confidence in Hormuz has been 'crushed' by war on Iran, IEA says
articles.originalDescription: Confidence in Hormuz has been 'crushed' by war on Iran, IEA says Submitted by MEE staff on Thu, 11/19/2026 - 21:17 Energy chief says world can 'manage without Hormuz' but it will require $240bn in investments An Iraqi government forces member walks next to a pipeline at the Bai Hassan Oil Field, west of the northern Iraqi city of Kirkuk, on 19 October 2017 (Ahmad al-Rubaye/AFP) Off The US-Israeli war on Iran has “crushed” confidence in the Strait of Hormuz as a reliable waterway for the export of energy, Fatih Birol, the head of the International Energy Agency (IEA), has warned. “I don’t see any credible pathway back to the situation that existed in February 2026,” Birol wrote for The Economist magazine in an essay published on Wednesday. “Shipping flows through the Strait of Hormuz have been blocked once, with a hugely disruptive effect on oil and gas markets. It can happen again. Confidence in the Strait as a safe and reliable corridor for energy and other goods has been crushed,” he added. Birol said that the world "can conceivably manage without the strait," but it would be "difficult". In its World Energy Outlook report published on Thursday, the IEA said developing alternative pipelines around the waterway would require around $40bn. This would add around $2 to the cost of a barrel of oil exported from the Middle East. An additional $200bn would need to be spent on alternative sources of energy outside the Middle East. The IEA said that in the case of oil alone, new pipeline projects are under construction or consideration in the Middle East that could pump around seven million barrels per day of oil, allowing producers to reach international markets without going through the strait. “If all these projects are completed, non-Gulf producers step up output, and importers bring down demand, then our Low Hormuz Case reduces the need for transit through the Strait to 2 mbp by 2035,” the IEA said, summarising how the strategic waterway could be made less relevant. Itu berhasil dua kali, sekali pada bulan Mei dan sekali pada bulan Juni, tapi gagal pada hari Kamis dengan suara 51- 48. 50 anggota Partai Republik dan Demokrat Senator John Fetterman memilih untuk menentang resolusi, sementara hanya 43 partai Demokrat yang mendukung pemilihan suara. articles.originalTitle: Senate vote to curb Trump war on Iran fails again
articles.originalDescription: Senate vote to curb Trump war on Iran fails again Submitted by Yasmine El-Sabawi on Thu, 11/19/2026 - 20:25 This is the 15th time lawmakers have tried to pass a largely symbolic resolution A temporary security fence is erected outside the US Capitol building in Washington, DC, on 19 November 2026 (Reuters/Cedeno) Off For the 15th time this year, the US Senate has tried to curb President Donald Trump's warmaking authority in Iran. It succeeded twice, once in May and once in June, but failed on Thursday by a vote of 51-48. Fifty Republicans and Democratic Senator John Fetterman voted against the resolution, while only 43 Democrats were present to vote in favour. They were joined by two Independents, and three Republicans in Rand Paul, Lisa Murkowski, and Susan Collins. Republican Senator Thom Tillis, who previously voted alongside Democrats, suggested the repeat votes were becoming fruitless, telling reporters on Thursday that there should be "more weight on solving the fundamental problem" instead. Tillis decided not to run in this month's midterm elections after a spate of Trump-led attacks on him last year. He will now be replaced by Democrat Roy Cooper, the senator-elect, in North Carolina. The election results were a decisive rebuke of the Trump administration's domestic and foreign policy, as Vice President JD Vance himself acknowledged the very next day . Trump has previously just ignored the two successful resolutions stipulating that only Congress has the authority to declare - and thereby fund - the US at war. The move effectively rendered the Senate's efforts moot. After the 23 June vote, which was adopted 50-48, the White House responded that "there are no present hostilities from which to remove US Armed Forces", because "the hostilities that began on February 28, 2026, have terminated with the ceasefire ordered by the President on April 7, 2026". articles.title: Kepala GCC mengutuk serangan Houthi terhadap KAFD, menyerukan tindakan internasional
articles.description: RIYADH - Dewan Kerjasama Teluk (GCC) Sekretaris Jenderal Jasem Albudaiwi dikutuk dalam kondisi terkuat serangan teroris berbahaya dilakukan oleh milisi Houthi terhadap salah satu menara di Distrik Keuangan King Abdullah (KAFD) di Riyadh. "Serangan ini merupakan pelanggaran terang-terangan dari Kerajaan kedaulatan Arab Saudi dan eskalasi yang berbahaya, mencerminkan milisi terus ancaman terhadap kehidupan sipil, menargetkan fasilitas sipil, dan upaya untuk melemahkan keamanan dan stabilitas daerah," katanya dalam sebuah pernyataan. Albudaiwi memanggil komunitas internasional dan Dewan Keamanan PBB untuk memenuhi tanggung jawab mereka dan mengambil langkah-langkah efektif untuk menahan milisi Houthi yang bertanggung jawab atas tindakan teroris dan mencegah ancaman lebih lanjut. Dia menekankan bahwa kegagalan untuk mengambil tindakan tegas terhadap serangan terhadap warga sipil dan fasilitas sipil akan mendorong milisi untuk melaksanakan serangan lebih lanjut dan meningkatkan risiko untuk regional dan internasional keamanan dan stabilitas. Kepala GCC menegaskan kembali solidaritas yang penuh dan tak tergoyahkan dengan Arab Saudi dan dukungan mereka untuk semua langkah yang diperlukan untuk melindungi keamanan, kedaulatan, dan integritas teritorial, serta keselamatan warganya dan warganya.
articles.originalTitle: GCC chief condemns Houthi attack on KAFD, calls for international action
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) Secretary General Jasem Albudaiwi condemned in the strongest terms the treacherous terrorist attack carried out by the Houthi militia against one of the towers in the King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD) in Riyadh. “The attack constitutes a blatant violation of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's sovereignty and a dangerous escalation, reflecting the militia's continued threats to civilian lives, targeting of civilian facilities, and efforts to undermine regional security and stability,” he said in a statement. Albudaiwi called on the international community and the UN Security Council to fulfill their responsibilities and take effective measures to hold the Houthi militia accountable for its terrorist acts and prevent further threats. He stressed that failure to take firm action against attacks on civilians and civilian facilities would encourage the militia to carry out further attacks and increase risks to regional and international security and stability. The GCC chief reaffirmed the Gulf states' full and unwavering solidarity with Saudi Arabia and their support for all measures it takes to protect its security, sovereignty, and territorial integrity, as well as the safety of its citizens and residents.

articles.title: Arab, negara-negara Islam hujan es Inggris, Australia sanksi pada ilegal Israel pemukiman
articles.description: RIYADH - Menteri Urusan Luar Negeri Arab Saudi dan beberapa negara Arab lainnya serta negara-negara Islam menyambut keputusan pemerintah Inggris dan Australia untuk menuntut sanksi untuk menanggapi kegiatan pemukiman ilegal Israel di Wilayah Palestina, termasuk langkah-langkah menargetkan perusahaan yang terlibat dalam konstruksi pemukiman. Dalam pernyataan bersama, mereka juga menyambut keputusan Inggris untuk menyetujui organisasi menghalangi pengiriman bantuan kemanusiaan ke Gaza. Negara-negara termasuk Jordan, Mesir, Pakistan, Indonesia, Qatar, Uni Emirat Arab, Niger, Palestina, Libya, Maldives, Türkiye, Kuwait, Aljazair, Somalia dan Oman. Para menteri menyatakan dukungan untuk semua upaya untuk memastikan akuntabilitas, termasuk melalui langkah-langkah internasional yang tepat dan tuntutan sanksi terhadap entitas dan individu yang bertanggung jawab untuk kegiatan penyelesaian, termasuk rencana pemukiman E1, serta mereka yang mendukung, memfasilitasi atau mengimplementasikan ekspansi penyelesaian dan kebijakan aneksasi. Para menteri memperbaharui kutukan terkuat mereka atas kebijakan penyelesaian yang berkelanjutan di Wilayah Palestina, terutama "E1" rencana pemukiman dan terkait pemukiman timur dari menduduki Yerusalem Timur. Mereka menyatakan harapan bahwa keputusan ini oleh Inggris dan Australia akan mendorong banyak orang di komunitas internasional untuk mengikutinya. Para menteri mempertimbangkan langkah-langkah ini untuk sejalan dengan hukum internasional dan resolusi yang relevan PBB, termasuk resolusi Dewan Keamanan Perserikatan PBB 2334 dari 2016, dan Pernyataan Penasehat Internasional Keadilan Juli 19, 2024, termasuk kewajiban semua negara untuk tidak mengakui sebagai hukum situasi yang timbul dari pendudukan yang melanggar hukum Israel dan tidak untuk memberikan bantuan atau bantuan dalam mempertahankan situasi yang diciptakan oleh pendudukan Israel. articles.originalTitle: Arab, Islamic states hail UK, Australia sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Ministers of foreign affairs of Saudi Arabia and several other Arab and Islamic countries welcomed the decisions of the governments of the United Kingdom and Australia to impose sanctions in response to illegal Israeli settlement activities in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including measures targeting companies involved in settlement construction. In a joint statement, they also welcome the United Kingdom’s decision to sanction an organization obstructing the delivery of humanitarian aid to Gaza.The countries also include Jordan, Egypt, Pakistan, Indonesia, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates, Niger, Palestine, Libya, Maldives, Türkiye, Kuwait, Algeria, Somalia and Oman. The ministers expressed support for all efforts to ensure accountability, including through appropriate international measures and the imposition of sanctions on entities and individuals responsible for settlement activities, including the E1 settlement plan, as well as those that support, facilitate or implement settlement expansion and annexation policies. The ministers renewed their strongest condemnation of Israel’s continued settlement policies in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, particularly the “E1” settlement plan and related settlement activities east of occupied East Jerusalem. They expressed the hope that this decision by the UK and Australia would encourage many in the international community to follow suit. The ministers consider these measures to be in line with international law and relevant United Nations resolutions, including United Nations Security Council resolution 2334 of 2016, and the Advisory Opinion of the International Court of Justice of July 19, 2024, including the obligation of all states not to recognize as legal the situation arising from Israel’s unlawful occupation and not to render aid or assistance in maintaining the situation created by Israel’s occupation. articles.description: Qatar, Kuwait, GCC mengutuk serangan terhadap distrik finansial Riyadh, kementrian luar negeri Kuwait menawarkan "kutukan yang kuat" pada hari Kamis karena serangan Houthi di Arab Saudi yang menyebabkan kerusakan materi pada Distrik Raja Abdullah Financial. Departemen Luar Negeri Qatar juga sangat mengutuk apa yang digambarkan sebagai "tindakan agresi yang memalukan, mengabaikan kehidupan warga sipil, pelanggaran terang-terangan atas kedaulatan Arab Saudi, dan pelanggaran yang jelas dari prinsip-prinsip hukum internasional" dalam sebuah pernyataan yang diposting pada Sekretaris Dewan Kolaborasi X. Pernyataan 124; Negara Qatar menyatakan, dalam kondisi terkuat, serangan yang berkelanjutan oleh Houthis terhadap Kerajaan Saudi Arab, yang menargetkan fasilitas warga sipil dan ekonomi serta infrastruktur sipil di ibukota, Riyadh, menyebabkan kerusakan materi pada Distrik Raja Abdullah. Negara Qatar menggambarkan serangan ini sebagai tindakan agresi yang memalukan, mengabaikan kehidupan warga sipil secara terang-terangan, pelanggaran kedaulatan Arab Saudi, dan pelanggaran yang jelas terhadap prinsip-prinsip hukum internasional. Kementerian lebih lanjut meninjau kembali solidaritas penuh Negara Qatar dengan Kerajaan Persaudaraan Arab Saudi, dan dukungannya untuk semua tindakan yang sah yang diambil oleh Kerajaan untuk menjaga kedaulatan, keamanan, integritas teritorial, dan kepentingan. Hal ini menekankan bahwa keamanan Arab Saudi adalah bagian integral keamanan Qatar sendiri dan sistem keamanan kolektif Dewan Kerja Teluk (GCC) negara bagian. # MOFAQatar - Kementerian Luar Negeri - Qatar (@ MofaQatar _ EN) 19 November 2026

The State of Qatar describes these assaults as a disgraceful act of aggression, an unacceptable disregard for civilian lives, a blatant violation of Saudi Arabia's sovereignty, and a clear breach of the principles of international law. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs emphasizes the State of Qatar's categorical rejection of attacks on civilians and civilian objects, and underscores the need for an immediate halt to these irresponsible acts. The Ministry further reiterates the State of Qatar's full solidarity with the sisterly Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and its support for all legitimate measures taken by the Kingdom to safeguard its sovereignty, security, territorial integrity, and interests. articles.title: Sepuluh tewas dalam serangan Saudi di Sanaa lebih dari dua hari, Departemen Kesehatan Houthi mengatakan
articles.description: Sepuluh tewas dalam serangan Saudi di Sanaa selama dua hari, pelayanan kesehatan Houthi mengatakan Saudi didukung pemerintah Yaman mengatakan pada hari Kamis bahwa mereka membunuh atau terluka setidaknya 144 Houthi komandan dan pejuang dalam beberapa jam terakhir. Spokesman Macing al- Nuzaili mengatakan dalam sebuah pos di X bahwa pasukan yang meluncurkan setidaknya 715 operasi yang ditargetkan terhadap Houthis di Taiz, Marib dan pemerintah Jawf, termasuk setidaknya 631 serangan artileri dan 36 serangan pesawat tak berawak. Sementara itu, pasukan koalisi Saudi- dipimpin dilakukan setidaknya 15 serangan udara. Departemen Kesehatan Houthi mengatakan pada hari Kamis bahwa beberapa serangan oleh Saudi- dipimpin koalisi di ibukota Yaman, Sanaa, membunuh 10 orang selama dua hari terakhir, salah satunya diduga menargetkan sebuah footwear dan pabrik tekstil di lingkungan al- Nahda, menurut kantor berita Saba.
articles.originalTitle: Ten killed in Saudi strikes in Sanaa over two days, Houthi health ministry says
articles.originalDescription: Ten killed in Saudi strikes in Sanaa over two days, Houthi health ministry says Yemen’s Saudi-backed government forces said on Thursday that they killed or wounded at least 144 Houthi commanders and fighters in recent hours. Spokesman Majed al-Nuzaili said in a post on X that forces launched at least 715 targeted operations against the Houthis in Taiz, Marib and al-Jawf governorates, including at least 631 artillery strikes and 36 drone strikes. Meanwhile, Saudi-led coalition forces carried out at least 15 air strikes. The Houthi health ministry said on Thursday that several strikes by the Saudi-led coalition on Yemen’s capital, Sanaa, killed 10 people over the past two days, one of which allegedly targeted a footwear and textile factory in the al-Nahda neighbourhood, according to Saba news agency.

articles.title: Setidaknya 300 anak meninggal di Gaza menunggu izin Israel untuk mendapatkan cuti medis
articles.description: Setidaknya 300 anak meninggal di Gaza menunggu izin medis Israel untuk meninggalkan pelayanan kesehatan Gaza mengatakan pada hari Kamis bahwa setidaknya 300 anak-anak telah meninggal menunggu izin Israel untuk meninggalkan perawatan medis, termasuk setidaknya 90 anak menderita kanker. 5.400 anak lainnya masih dalam daftar perjalanan medis, menunggu untuk mengamankan otorisasi Israel untuk meninggalkan enclave, tambahan petugas kesehatan. Pada bulan Februari, pelayanan melaporkan bahwa 1,360 pasien di Gaza meninggal saat menunggu izin perjalanan medis setelah persimpangan Rafah ditutup pada bulan Mei 2024. Seorang gadis Palestina membawa kucing dalam sebuah kandang transportasi berjalan sepanjang jalan ketika warga mengevakuasi rumah mereka dan tenda penampungan di Nuseirat, pusat Jalur Gaza pada 18 November 2026 (Eyad Baba / AFP)
articles.originalTitle: At least 300 children died in Gaza waiting for Israel's permission to get medical leave
articles.originalDescription: At least 300 children died in Gaza waiting for Israel's permission to get medical leave Gaza’s health ministry said on Thursday that at least 300 children have died awaiting Israel's permission to leave for life-saving medical treatment, including at least 90 children suffering from cancer. Another 5,400 children are still on medical travel lists, waiting to secure Israeli authorisation to leave the enclave, health officials added. In February, the ministry reported that 1,360 patients in Gaza died while waiting for medical travel permits after the Rafah crossing was closed in May 2024. A Palestinian girl carrying cats in a transport cage walks along a road as residents evacuate their homes and tent shelters in Nuseirat, central Gaza Strip on 18 November 2026 (Eyad Baba/AFP)

articles.originalTitle: ‏Saudi Arabia ranks first globally in digital government services
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia has achieved a historic global milestone by securing first place worldwide in the Online Services Index (OSI) and a position among the world’s top five countries in the United Nations E-Government Development Index (EGDI). This remarkable accomplishment marks the Kingdom’s attainment of its Saudi Vision 2030 target four years ahead of schedule. Saudi Arabia also ranked first globally in the Telecommunications Infrastructure Index (TII), the Participation and Engagement Index (PE), and the E-Government Infrastructure Index (EGI), while Riyadh ranked first in the Local Online Services Index (LOSI), according to the UN report, which assessed 194 countries.Minister of Communications and Information Technology and Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Digital Government Authority Abdullah Alswaha extended his deepest gratitude and appreciation to Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman and Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman for the unlimited support provided to the digital economy. He said that this global achievement is the result of Saudi Vision 2030, which has made technology and innovation key drivers of development, global competitiveness, and contributions to shaping the future.‎‏Digital Government Authority Governor Ahmed Alsuwaiyan expressed his profound gratitude and appreciation to the wise leadership for the continued support of the digital government ecosystem. He affirmed that this significant achievement reflects the maturity of digital transformation and the integration of efforts among government agencies, demonstrating Saudi Arabia’s progress in developing integrated, proactive, and human-centric digital government services. Rekaman video dari ibukota Saudi menunjukkan kru telah bekerja untuk menggantikan kaca. articles.originalTitle: Houthis hit Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund skyscraper
articles.originalDescription: Houthis hit Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund skyscraper Submitted by MEE staff on Thu, 11/19/2026 - 16:31 Saudi crown prince meets Centcom commander in Riyadh amid high profile attack A screengrab from a social media video shows a projectile hitting the Public Investment Fund tower, Riyadh's tallest skyscraper, as it was struck by a suspected Houthi missile, in Riyadh, on 19 November 2026 (Social Media/via Reuters) Off The skyscraper housing Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund (PIF) in Riyadh was damaged on Thursday by a Houthi strike, the kingdom has confirmed. The strike destroyed windows across seven to eight floors of the tower, Riyadh's tallest skyscraper, and bent part of its metal facade, according to a Reuters journalist. Video footage shared from the Saudi capital showed crews already working to replace the glass. The attack is the second time this month that the Houthis have struck at the heart of Saudi Arabia’s image as a safe investment destination. PIF says it has around $1 trillion in assets. Earlier this month, the Houthis struck Aramco Tower in Riyadh. “One of the towers of the Financial Center in Riyadh was targeted in a terrorist attack by the terrorist Houthi militia, causing material damage but no injuries -praise be to God,” the Saudi authorities said in a statement released on Thursday. The press release included an image showing notable but relatively minor damage to the PIF headquarters. Video footage appeared to show a missile slamming into the 80-storey tower, but Middle East Eye could not independently verify the footage. Reuters reported that three sources said the building was struck by a missile while the kingdom said it had dealt with the incoming missile threat and that debris had fallen. Sources on the ground in Riyadh told MEE that they were awakened by a massive explosion around 5am. Sekolah dasar adalah bagian dari Akademi Singa, yang menjalankan 11 akademisi utama di London timur. Mencegah Watch, yang telah mendukung keluarga selama tiga belas tahun pertempuran hukum, dikonfirmasi kepada MEE bahwa pengadilan menyetujui penyelesaian pada hari Kamis setelah keluarga, diwakili oleh firma hukum Leigh Day, membawa klaim di bawah UU Kesetaraan 2010 dan Human Rights Act 1998. Kasus ini telah memperbarui kekhawatiran tentang penggunaan kerangka balik terorisme Inggris dalam pengaturan pendidikan dan perawatan solidaritas Palestina di sekolah. articles.originalTitle: UK school pays compensation to children threatened over Palestinian badges
articles.originalDescription: UK school pays compensation to children threatened over Palestinian badges Submitted by Areeb Ullah on Thu, 11/19/2026 - 16:12 Lion Academy Trust threatened to refer children to Prevent for wearing colours in memory of children killed in Gaza Hundreds of parents and supporters staged a protest outside Barclay primary school in east London after the Lion Academy Trust did not respond to a parent letter (Supplied) Off A UK school trust has apologised and agreed to pay compensation to four children who were threatened with referrals to the government’s counterterrorism Prevent programme after wearing Palestinian colours and badges at a school charity event. The children attended Barclay Primary School in Leyton, east London, in November 2023, when they wore Palestinian colours in memory of children killed in Gaza during the school’s Children in Need event. The primary school is part of the Lion Academy Trust, which runs 11 primary academies in east London. Following the event, the children's parents received letters warning that they could be referred to Prevent or to the police’s hate crime unit for wearing the Palestine flag or its colours, which it deemed “overt demonstrations of political beliefs” that could be “deemed offensive". Middle East Eye understands that the letter was sent to the families of a number of children, including an eight-year-old who lost 14 members of his family in Gaza. Prevent Watch, which has supported the families throughout its three-year legal battle, confirmed to MEE that a court approved the settlement on Thursday after the families, represented by law firm Leigh Day, brought claims under the Equality Act 2010 and the Human Rights Act 1998. The case has renewed concerns about the use of the UK’s counterterrorism framework in educational settings and the treatment of Palestinian solidarity in schools. articles.title: ICJ memerintah genosida Rohingya bisa memperkuat kasus Afrika Selatan terhadap Israel
articles.description: ICJ menentang genosida Rohingya dapat memperkuat kasus Afrika Selatan terhadap Israel. Pengadilan Internasional Hakim memutuskan bahwa Myanmar melakukan genosida terhadap Rohingya dapat memiliki banyak konsekuensi untuk Israel, setelah hakim menolak argumen bahwa operasi militer terhadap kelompok bersenjata memberikan penjelasan yang memadai untuk kampanye pembunuhan massal, kekerasan seksual dan kehancuran yang meluas. Penilaian, pertama kalinya pengadilan tertinggi PBB menyatakan bertanggung jawab atas genosida, menawarkan preseden hukum yang berpotensi signifikan dalam kasus ini menuduh Israel melakukan genosida melawan Palestina di Gaza, terutama atas bagaimana hakim menilai niat genosida ketika negara mengklaim tindakan militer didorong oleh tujuan keamanan. Dalam keputusan 9- 6 pada hari Kamis, ICJ menemukan bahwa pasukan keamanan Myanmar telah melakukan genosida terhadap populasi Rohingya di Negara Rakhine Utara selama operasi 2017 militer. "Satu-satunya alasan yang masuk akal yang dapat menjelaskan tindakan Myanmar adalah niat untuk menghancurkan sebagian besar dari kelompok yang dilindungi, yaitu populasi Rohingya di Negara Rakhine Utara", kata pengadilan. Penilaian ini sangat penting bagi kasus Afrika Selatan, yang bergantung pada penetapan bahwa Israel bertindak dengan maksud khusus menghancurkan Palestina, secara keseluruhan atau sebagian, sebagai kelompok nasional, etnis, rasial atau agama. articles.originalTitle: ICJ ruling on Rohingya genocide could strengthen South Africa's case against Israel
articles.originalDescription: ICJ ruling on Rohingya genocide could strengthen South Africa's case against Israel The International Court of Justice's landmark ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya could have far-reaching consequences for Israel, after judges rejected the argument that military operations against armed groups provided an adequate explanation for a campaign of mass killings, sexual violence and widespread destruction. The judgment, the first time the UN's highest court has found a state responsible for genocide, offers South Africa a potentially significant legal precedent in its case accusing Israel of committing genocide against Palestinians in Gaza, particularly over how judges assess genocidal intent when a state claims its military actions are driven by security objectives. In a 9-6 decision on Thursday, the ICJ found that Myanmar's security forces had committed genocide against the Rohingya population in northern Rakhine State during the military's 2017 operations. "The only reasonable inference that can explain Myanmar's actions is an intention to destroy a substantial part of the protected group, namely the Rohingya population in Northern Rakhine State," the court said. The judgment is particularly significant for South Africa's case, which hinges on establishing that Israel acted with the specific intention of destroying Palestinians, in whole or in part, as a national, ethnic, racial or religious group. articles.title: Utusan perdagangan Inggris untuk Israel kembali akun troll yang menyerang Ed Miliband dan Buruh atas Muslim
articles.description: Utusan perdagangan Inggris untuk Israel kembali akun troll yang menyerang Ed Miliband dan Buruh atas Muslim Utusan perdagangan Inggris untuk Israel telah mendukung akun media sosial yang telah disparagingly berlabel sekretaris asing "Sekretaris Palestina" dan berulang kali menyerang pemerintah Tenaga Kerja, mengklaim itu mencoba untuk menenangkan Muslim. Awal minggu ini Byline Times melaporkan bahwa @ habibi _ uk, akun anonim pada X yang berkampanye melawan pro-Palestina tokoh publik di Inggris, adalah cucu Amerika-Inggris dari filsuf Bertrand Russell dan seorang ahli negara bagian AS dalam "diplomasi politik-militer" yang disebut Benjamin Tait. Tait telah sebelumnya bekerja dengan Lord Ian Austin, mantan MP dan rekan hidup yang telah menjadi utusan perdagangan ke Israel di bawah pemerintahan berturut-turut sejak Juli 2019. Austin memposting di X pada hari Rabu, sebagai respon terhadap akun Habibi: "Teruskan", diikuti dengan dua emoji lengan berotot dan dua emoji bertepuk tangan. Habibi telah memberi label Sekretaris Luar Negeri Inggris Ed Miliband "Palestina Sekretaris", berkomentar bulan lalu: "Oh lihat, Sekretaris Palestina bekerja keras". articles.originalTitle: UK trade envoy to Israel backs troll account which attacked Ed Miliband and Labour over Muslims
articles.originalDescription: UK trade envoy to Israel backs troll account which attacked Ed Miliband and Labour over Muslims The UK's trade envoy to Israel has endorsed a social media account which has disparagingly labelled the foreign secretary the "Palestine secretary" and repeatedly attacked the Labour government, claiming it is trying to appease Muslims. Earlier this week Byline Times reported that @habibi_uk, the anonymous account on X which campaigns against pro-Palestine public figures in the UK, is the American-British grandson of the philosopher Bertrand Russell and a US State Department-trained expert in "political-military diplomacy" called Benjamin Tait. Tait has previously worked with Lord Ian Austin, a former Labour MP and life peer who has been the trade envoy to Israel under successive governments since July 2019. Austin posted on X on Wednesday, in response to the Habibi account: "Keep going", followed by two emojis of a muscled arm and two clapping emojis. Habibi has labelled British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband the "Palestine Secretary", commenting last month: "Oh look, the Palestine Secretary is hard at work." articles.title: Dua orang Palestina tewas, beberapa terluka dalam serangan Israel di Gaza
articles.description: Dua orang Palestina tewas, beberapa terluka dalam serangan Israel di seluruh Gaza Dua Palestina tewas dan beberapa lainnya terluka pada hari Kamis dalam serangan Israel menargetkan beberapa daerah di Jalur Gaza. Saksi mata, Berita Wafa melaporkan bahwa pesawat tak berawak Israel menembaki sekelompok orang Palestina di Jalan Salah Al- Din, tenggara Gaza City, membunuh satu orang seketika. Palestina lain tewas ketika artileri Israel shelled Zeitoun lingkungan timur Gaza City dengan beberapa putaran. Sementara itu, dua orang Palestina, termasuk seorang anak, terluka oleh tembakan di barat Siham School Khan Younis di Gaza selatan, dan lainnya terluka dalam serangan pesawat tak berawak Israel di stasiun Bahloul, tempat penampungan untuk pengungsi orang-orang di timur Gaza City.
articles.originalTitle: Two Palestinians killed, several injured in Israeli attacks across Gaza
articles.originalDescription: Two Palestinians killed, several injured in Israeli attacks across Gaza Two Palestinians were killed and several others injured on Thursday in Israeli attacks targeting multiple areas across the Gaza Strip. Citing eyewitnesses, Wafa news reported that an Israeli drone opened fire on a group of Palestinians on Salah al-Din Street, southeast of Gaza City, killing one person instantly. Another Palestinian was killed when Israeli artillery shelled the Zeitoun neighbourhood east of Gaza City with several rounds. Meanwhile, two Palestinians, including a child, were injured by Israeli gunfire at the Siham School west of Khan Younis in southern Gaza, and another was injured in an Israeli drone strike on Bahloul station, a shelter for displaced people east of Gaza City.

articles.title: Saudi, menteri asing Suriah bertemu untuk membahas penguatan keamanan regional
articles.description: RIYADH - Menteri Luar Negeri Pangeran Faisal bin Farhan menerima Menteri Luar Negeri Suriah dan Expatriates Asaad Al- Shaibani di kantor pusat kementerian di Riyadh pada hari Kamis. Selama pertemuan, mereka meninjau hubungan persaudaraan antara dua negara dan rakyat mereka, serta cara untuk meningkatkan kerjasama bersama dalam berbagai bidang. Mereka juga mendiskusikan perkembangan regional terbaru dan tantangan yang dihadapi wilayah tersebut. Para menteri menekankan pentingnya mengintensifkan koordinasi dan konsultasi mengenai isu-isu ini untuk berkontribusi untuk memperkuat keamanan daerah dan stabilitas. Dr. Saud Al- Sati, Wakil Menteri Luar Negeri untuk urusan politik, dan Pangeran Musab Al- Farhan, penasihat Menteri Luar Negeri untuk urusan politik, juga menghadiri pertemuan.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi, Syrian foreign ministers meet to discuss strengthening regional security
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Minister of Foreign Affairs Prince Faisal bin Farhan received Syrian Minister of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates Asaad Al-Shaibani at the ministry's headquarters in Riyadh on Thursday. During the meeting, they reviewed the fraternal relations between the two countries and their peoples, as well as ways to further enhance joint cooperation in various fields. They also discussed the latest regional developments and challenges facing the region. The ministers emphasized the importance of intensifying coordination and consultation regarding these issues to contribute to strengthening regional security and stability. Dr. Saud Al-Sati, undersecretary of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for political affairs, and Prince Musab Al-Farhan, advisor to the Minister of Foreign Affairs for political affairs, also attended the meeting.

articles.description: RIYADH - Direktorat Umum Pertahanan Sipil mendorong orang untuk berlatih hati-hati dan tetap di tempat yang aman di tengah-tengah perkiraan badai petir terus memukul beberapa daerah Arab Saudi melalui Selasa depan. Ini disebut pada publik untuk menjauh dari daerah flood- rawan dan lembah, serta untuk menghindari berenang di dalamnya, dan mengikuti petunjuk dari pihak yang bersangkutan. Pusat Nasional untuk Meteorologi (NCM) mengatakan bahwa daerah Mekah akan terpengaruh oleh curah hujan menengah disertai dengan banjir kilat, hujan es, dan angin turun mengaduk debu dan pasir. Hal ini menambahkan bahwa Jazan, Asir, dan Al- Baha daerah akan terpengaruh dengan moderat untuk hujan deras disertai dengan banjir kilat, hujan es, dan angin turun mengaduk debu dan pasir.
articles.originalTitle: Civil Defense urges caution as thunderstorms set to persist through Tuesday
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The General Directorate of Civil Defense urged people to exercise caution and remain in safe places amid forecast of thunderstorms continue hitting some regions of Saudi Arabia through next Tuesday. It called on the public to stay away from flood-prone areas and valleys, as well as to avoid swimming in them, and follow instructions of the concerned authorities. The National Center for Meteorology (NCM) said that the Makkah region will be affected by moderate rainfall accompanied by flash floods, hail, and downdraft winds stirring up dust and sand. It added that Jazan, Asir, and Al-Baha regions will be affected by moderate to heavy rainfall accompanied by flash floods, hail, and downdraft winds stirring up dust and sand.

articles.title: Arab Saudi untuk memperkenalkan minimum domestik top-up pajak untuk multinasional efektif Jan. 1, 2027
articles.description: RIYADH - Sumbangan, Pajak dan Otoritas Bea Cukai (ZATCA) telah mengumumkan bahwa itu akan mulai menerapkan pajak minimum domestik (DMTT) efektif 1 Januari 2027. Pajak tersebut berlaku untuk entitas konstituen perusahaan multinasional (MNE) kelompok yang telah mengkonsolidasikan pendapatan tahunan setidaknya 750 juta euro atau setara dalam riyal Saudi. Otoritas tersebut menegaskan bahwa pajak akan berlaku untuk pertemuan entitas ambang pendapatan ini sesuai dengan pernyataan keuangan konsolidasikan dari entitas orangtua utama setidaknya dua dari empat tahun fiskal awal tahun di mana pajak diterapkan. Lingkup aplikasi terbatas pada entitas yang memenuhi kriteria eligibilitas dalam kelompok multinasional dan tidak diperpanjang ke semua perusahaan yang beroperasi di Arab Saudi. Oleh karena itu, itu termasuk murni perusahaan domestik yang tidak memiliki cabang di luar Arab Saudi atau tidak termasuk dalam kelompok MNE tertutup. Pajak ini didasarkan pada pernyataan keuangan konsolidasikan dari entitas orangtua terakhir setidaknya dalam dua dari empat tahun sebelum tahun fiskal di mana pajak berlaku, dalam langkah ditujukan untuk melindungi hak pajak Arab Saudi dan menjaga kecepatan dengan perkembangan pajak internasional. Menurut siaran pers yang dikeluarkan oleh ZATCA pada hari Kamis, pajak ini datang dalam kerangka kerja internasional yang bertujuan untuk menetapkan aturan minimum global di bawah Pillar Dua, dipimpin oleh Organisasi untuk Operasi dan Pengembangan Cotik Ekonomi (OECD) dan G20, dengan demikian berkontribusi pada perlindungan hak pajak Kerajaan atas keuntungan yang dihasilkan dalam yurisdiksi oleh kelompok MNE. ZATCA menjelaskan bahwa DMTT memungkinkan untuk koleksi pajak atas-atas dalam Kerajaan pada keuntungan kapanpun tingkat pajak yang efektif turun di bawah batas minimal global 15 persen, sesuai dengan aturan yang relevan. Persentase ini mengacu pada tingkat pajak minimal yang efektif pada keuntungan dan bukan pada total pendapatan perusahaan. Otoritas
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia to introduce domestic minimum top-up tax for multinationals effective Jan. 1, 2027
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) has announced that it will start implementing the domestic minimum top-up tax (DMTT) effective January 1, 2027. The tax applies to constituent entities of multinational enterprise (MNE) groups that have consolidated annual revenues of at least 750 million euro or its equivalent in Saudi riyal. The authority clarified that the tax will apply to entities meeting this revenue threshold according to the consolidated financial statements of the ultimate parent entity in at least two of the four fiscal years preceding the year in which the tax is applied. The scope of application is limited to entities that meet the eligibility criteria within multinational groups and does not extend to all companies operating in Saudi Arabia. Accordingly, it excludes purely domestic companies that do not have branches outside Saudi Arabia or do not belong to a covered MNE group. The tax is based on the consolidated financial statements of the ultimate parent entity in at least two of the four fiscal years preceding the fiscal year in which the tax applies, in a step aimed at protecting Saudi Arabia's tax rights and keeping pace with international tax developments. According to a press release issued by the ZATCA on Thursday, this tax comes within the framework of international trends aimed at establishing global minimum tax rules under Pillar Two, led by the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) and the G20, thereby contributing to the protection of the Kingdom's tax rights on profits generated within its jurisdiction by the covered MNE groups. ZATCA explained that the DMTT allows for the collection of the top-up tax within the Kingdom on profits whenever the effective tax rate falls below the established global minimum threshold of 15 percent, in accordance with the relevant rules. Perjanjian ini merupakan tonggak penting dalam perjalanan Inggris menuju Expo 2030 Riyadh, membangun kerangka kerja untuk eksekusi paviliun, pemrograman dan pengalaman pengunjung. articles.title: Sepeda listrik meningkatkan 'Perjalanan Absher untuk Layanan Pengunjung di perbatasan darat'
articles.description: RIYADH - Direktorat Umum Passport adalah prosedur entri untuk wisatawan di perbatasan darat dengan menyebarkan sepeda listrik untuk paspor personil keamanan untuk membantu pengguna dari "Perjalanan Absher untuk Pengunjung" layanan. * * media [2796780] * * Layanan ini tersedia untuk warga Dewan Kerjasama Teluk (GCC) negara-negara dan pengunjung tiba di Kerajaan oleh tanah. Sepeda memungkinkan personil keamanan paspor mencapai pengguna lebih cepat sehingga untuk memberikan mereka dengan dukungan. Direktorat mendesak wisatawan untuk menggunakan layanan melalui aplikasi Absher. Layanan akan menjadi wajib enam bulan setelah 26 Oktober 2026. Hal ini dirancang untuk memasukkan otomatis prosedur bagi wisatawan dan kendaraan mereka dengan memungkinkan mereka untuk menyelesaikan persyaratan perjalanan digital sebelum tiba di perbatasan melintasi Kingdom.
articles.originalTitle: Electric bikes enhance 'Absher Travel for Visitors' service at land border crossings
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The General Directorate of Passports is streamlining entry procedures for travelers at land border crossings by deploying electric bikes for passport security personnel to assist users of the "Absher Travel for Visitors" service. **media[2796780]**This service is available to citizens of Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries and visitors arriving in the Kingdom by land. The bikes allow passport security personnel to reach users faster so as to provide them with support. The directorate urged travelers to use the service via the Absher app. The service will become mandatory six months after October 26, 2026. It is designed to automate entry procedures for travelers and their vehicles by allowing them to complete travel requirements digitally before arriving at the border crossing across the Kingdom.

articles.title: Kedutaan Besar AS di Riyadh menyangkal laporan serangan pesawat tak berawak
articles.description: RIYADH - Kedutaan Besar AS di Riyadh pada Kamis menyangkal laporan dan klaim beredar di media sosial yang menyatakan bahwa tempatnya telah ditargetkan dalam serangan pesawat tak berawak, menegaskan bahwa klaim ini sepenuhnya palsu. "Klaim beredar online bahwa Kedutaan Besar AS di Riyadh telah terkena serangan pesawat tanpa awak hari ini adalah palsu," kata kedutaan dalam pernyataan pada akun X nya. Beberapa hari yang lalu, Kedutaan Besar mendesak warga AS untuk meninjau Departemen Perjalanan Negara untuk Amerika tentang Arab Saudi untuk informasi keamanan tambahan dan bimbingan perjalanan. "Amerika saat ini di Timur Tengah harus melatih tingkat kewaspadaan karena meningkatnya ancaman serangan bersenjata oleh Iran - mendukung upaya Houthis dan Iran untuk menargetkan pejabat pemerintah AS di wilayah tersebut", kata kedutaan dalam nasihatnya dikeluarkan pada Nov 14.
articles.originalTitle: US Embassy in Riyadh denies drone attack reports
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The US Embassy in Riyadh on Thursday categorically denied reports and claims circulating on social media alleging that its premises had been targeted in a drone attack, affirming that these claims were entirely false.“Claims circulating online that the U.S. Embassy in Riyadh has been hit by a drone strike today are false,” the embassy said in a statement on its X account. A few days ago, the Embassy urged U.S. citizens to review the Department of State’s travel advisory for Americans regarding Saudi Arabia for additional security information and travel guidance. “Americans currently in the Middle East should exercise heightened vigilance due to the increased threat of armed attacks by Iranian-supported Houthis and Iranian efforts to target U.S. government officials in the region,” the embassy said in its advisory issued on Nov. 14.

articles.title: Tabungan harta sebesar US Arabia jatuh $5.33 miliar menjadi $135.9 miliar pada bulan September
articles.description: WASHIINGTON - Arab Saudi kepemilikan Keamanan Keuangan AS jatuh sekitar $5.33 miliar di September 2026 menjadi $135.9 miliar, turun dari sekitar $141,2 miliar pada Agustus, menurut Departemen Keuangan AS. Kerajaan ini berada di peringkat 18 secara global di antara pemegang terbesar di US Treasury Securities. Data keuangan menunjukkan bahwa kepemilikan Arab Saudi terdiri dari 112.8 miliar dolar dalam sekuritas jangka panjang, akuntansi sebesar 83 persen total, dan $23,1 miliar dalam sekuritas jangka pendek, mewakili 17 persen sisanya. Secara global, Jepang berperingkat sebagai pemegang asing terbesar AS Treasury Securities dengan $1,06 triliun, diikuti oleh Inggris dengan sekitar $985.8 miliar dan Cina dengan $563,9 miliar. Sementara itu, kepemilikan investor asing dari US Treasury Securities menurun sekitar $75.5 miliar September hingga $9.24 triliun, menandai penurunan bulanan terbesar dalam enam bulan dan tingkat terendah dalam setahun.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia’s US Treasury holdings fall $5.33 billion to $135.9 billion in September
articles.originalDescription: WASHIINGTON — Saudi Arabia's holdings of US Treasury securities fell by approximately $5.33 billion in September 2026 to $135.9 billion, down from around $141.2 billion in August, according to the US Department of the Treasury. The Kingdom ranked 18th globally among the largest foreign holders of US Treasury securities. Treasury data showed that Saudi Arabia's holdings comprised $112.8 billion in long-term securities, accounting for 83 percent of the total, and $23.1 billion in short-term securities, representing the remaining 17 percent. Globally, Japan ranked as the largest foreign holder of US Treasury securities with $1.06 trillion, followed by the United Kingdom with approximately $985.8 billion and China with $563.9 billion. Meanwhile, foreign investors' holdings of US Treasury securities declined by approximately $75.5 billion in September to $9.24 trillion, marking the largest monthly drop in six months and the lowest level in a year.

Namun, ia merasa dipaksa untuk meninggalkan pada tahun 2019, percaya bahwa Houthis (juga dikenal sebagai Tuhan) berjuang untuk tujuan mulia di Yaman dan bahwa ia perlu untuk mendukung mereka. Mukhtar telah tinggal di daerah yang dikendalikan oleh pemerintah Arab Saudi, dan prospek untuk tinggal di sana lebih lama telah menjadi berbahaya. "Banyak pendukung Ansar Allah ditahan atau melarikan diri desa mereka, tidak hanya pejuang, tapi warga sipil dan syekh yang mendukung mereka. Kembali di desanya, Mukhtar telah bekerja sebagai petani dan paruh waktu broker, tapi ia kehilangan mata pencaharian ketika ia melarikan diri. articles.originalDescription: Cousin fights cousin as war in Yemen splits families down the middle Submitted by MEE correspondent on Wed, 11/18/2026 - 15:27 Communities fracture with loyalties split between the Houthis and the internationally recognised government A fighter loyal to Yemen's government on the front line around Mount al-Midan in Taiz province, on 26 October 2026 (Ahmad al-Basha/AFP) Off It wasn’t easy for Mukhtar, 45, to flee his home in the village where he was born and raised, 50 kilometres south of Taiz city. However, he felt forced to leave in 2019, believing that the Houthis (also known as Ansar Allah) were fighting for a noble cause in Yemen and that he needed to support them. Mukhtar had been living in an area controlled by the Saudi Arabia -backed government, and the prospect of staying there any longer had become dangerous. Many of his relatives, including his brothers and cousins, supported government forces, and he feared he might be detained, like so many others. “Many Ansar Allah supporters were detained or fled their villages; not just fighters, but civilians and sheikhs who supported them. So there was no choice but to flee my village and live in Ansar Allah-controlled areas,” Mukhtar told Middle East Eye. Back in his village, Mukhtar had worked as a farmer and part-time land broker, but he lost his livelihood when he fled. When he reached a Houthi area, he joined the group, convinced that they were driven not by money but by a desire to defend Islam. “Ansar Allah’s project is for the hereafter; they implement what is in the Quran rather than following the orders of foreign countries. Theirs is a project for the afterworld, not a project of mercenaries,” Mukhtar added. articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia, UK sign MoU to strengthen veterinary medicine regulation and safety
articles.originalDescription: LONDON — The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the UK's Veterinary Medicines Directorate (VMD) to strengthen cooperation in the regulation of veterinary medicines and products. The agreement was signed by SFDA Chief Executive Officer Dr. Hisham bin Saad Al-Jadhey and VMD Chief Executive Abigail Seager on the sidelines of a meeting of the International Coalition of Medicines Regulatory Authorities (ICMRA) working group on the development of medicines for small populations and rare diseases, held in London. The MoU aims to facilitate the exchange of regulatory and supervisory information and expertise to improve regulatory practices and enhance safety. It also covers cooperation and the exchange of expertise on the regulation and availability of veterinary medicines, evaluation requirements, regulatory practices and laboratory testing. The agreement includes oversight of manufacturers and veterinary products before and after marketing, as well as drawing on the expertise of specialists from both sides and implementing training programs to strengthen technical and regulatory capabilities. articles.description: Dalam penilaian sejarah, ICJ menyimpulkan bahwa Myanmar melakukan genosida terhadap Muslim Rohingya Diberikan oleh Sondos Asem pada Thu, 11 / 19 / 2026 - 08: 16 Pengadilan Atas PBB menyatakan bahwa Iwasawa Yuji bertanggung jawab atas kasus genosida dalam kasus bersejarah yang akan membantu membentuk keputusan dalam kasus di Afrika Selatan melawan Pengadilan Internasional Israel (ICJ) Presiden Iwasawa Yuji membaca keputusan Pengadilan dalam kasus genosida yang dibawa oleh Gambia melawan Myanmar, dengan 11 Amerika Serikat, pada sidang umum di Istana Perdamaian di The Hague pada 19 November 2026 (McGREGen Jumelet) di Pengadilan Internasional di Pengadilan Internasional (ClJ) yang dilakukan oleh pasukan Islam pada Kamis). Pengadilan mengatakan niat genosida adalah "satu-satunya kesimpulan yang masuk akal" yang dapat diambil dari bukti perilaku Myanmar diambil secara keseluruhan dan bahwa Mynamar dimaksudkan untuk menghancurkan sebagian besar dari kelompok yang dilindungi. Pengadilan menemukan bahwa Rohingya adalah kelompok etnis dilindungi di bawah Pasal II dari Konvensi Genosida. Para juri mengatakan bukti-bukti yang mendukung perkiraan bahwa 10.000 Rohingya tewas selama operasi 2017. Pengadilan mengidentifikasi sekitar 815.000 Rohingya tinggal di Rakhine utara sebelum operasi sebagai bagian dari kelompok yang ditargetkan. Para juri mengatakan bahwa populasi cukup besar, baik dalam istilah mutlak dan relatif terhadap populasi Rohingya di Myanmar, untuk membentuk bagian substansial dari kelompok. Juga memegang bahwa tindakan pasukan keamanan Mynmar disebabkan oleh negara, dan memerintahkan Mynmar untuk memberikan balasan kepada kelompok dan korban individu, termasuk memastikan kelompok itu kembali ke negara asal mereka dan memfasilitasi pencarian untuk menghilang. articles.originalTitle: In historic judgment, ICJ concludes that Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya Muslims
articles.originalDescription: In historic judgment, ICJ concludes that Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya Muslims Submitted by Sondos Asem on Thu, 11/19/2026 - 08:16 The UN's top court holds a state responsible for genocide in a historic precedent that will help shape the decision in South Africa's case against Israel International Court of Justice (ICJ) President Iwasawa Yuji reads the Court's judgment in the genocide case brought by Gambia against Myanmar, with 11 States intervening, at a public hearing at the Peace Palace in The Hague on 19 November 2026 (Jeroen Jumelet/AFP) Off Judges at the International Court of Justice (ICJ) in The Hague on Thursday concluded that Myanmar’s security forces committed genocide during the brutal 2017 “clearance operations” against its Muslim Rohingya minority. The court said genocidal intent was “the only reasonable inference” that could be drawn from the evidence of Myanmar's conduct taken as a whole and that Mynamar intended to destroy a substantial part of the protected group. The court found that the Rohingya are a protected ethnic group under Article II of the Genocide Convention. The judges said the evidence supported an estimate that 10,000 Rohingya were killed during the 2017 operations. The court identified the approximately 815,000 Rohingya living in northern Rakhine before the operations as the part of the group that was targeted. The judges said that population was large enough, both in absolute terms and relative to the Rohingya population in Myanmar, to constitute a substantial part of the group. It also held that the conduct of Myanmar’s security forces was attributable to the state, and ordered Mynmar to provide reparations to the group and individual victims, including ensuring the group's return to their home country and facilitating the search for the disappeared. articles.originalTitle: Saudi Defense Minister, US CENTCOM commander discuss defense cooperation, regional security
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Minister of Defense Prince Khalid bin Salman bin Abdulaziz met with Commander of U.S. Central Command General Brad Cooper in Riyadh on Thursday. Dia juga mengklaim bahwa rudal Teheran adalah "ke sekitar 12, 13% dari apa yang mereka, dan mereka ingin membuat kesepakatan, jadi saya tidak perlu bantuan. Saya tidak akan meminta bantuan apapun," tambahkan bahwa AS memiliki "kendali total Selat Hormuz". Putra Mahkota Saudi Mohammed bin Salman dan Menteri Pertahanan Pangeran Khalid bin Salman bin Abdullah bertemu kepala Komando Pusat AS di Riyadh. articles.title: Koalisi menghancurkan dua platform peluncuran rudal Houthi balistik yang digunakan untuk mencoba menyerang Arab Saudi
articles.description: RIYADH - Koalisi untuk mendukung Legitimasi di Yaman menghancurkan dua platform peluncuran rudal balistik Houthi di Yaman yang mengatur Saada dan Dhamar setelah mereka digunakan untuk mencoba menyerang daerah selatan Arab Saudi dan Riyadh. Juru bicara Koalisi Mayor Jenderal Turki Al- Malki mengumumkan Kamis pagi bahwa Koalisi telah menghancurkan platform peluncuran rudal di Saada. Al- Malki mengatakan milisi Houthi telah menggunakan platform dalam upaya serangan di Arab Saudi daerah selatan awal hari itu. Kemudian di pagi hari, Al- Malki mengumumkan penghancuran lain peluncuran rudal platform di Dhamar. Menurut Koalisi, milisi Houthi telah menggunakan platform dalam percobaan serangan terhadap Riyadh hari itu.
articles.originalTitle: Coalition destroys two Houthi ballistic missile launch platforms used in attempted attacks on Saudi Arabia
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen destroyed two Houthi ballistic missile launch platforms in the Yemeni governorates of Saada and Dhamar after they were used in attempted attacks on Saudi Arabia’s southern region and Riyadh. Coalition spokesperson Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Malki announced early Thursday morning that the Coalition had destroyed a ballistic missile launch platform in Saada. Al-Malki said the Houthi militia had used the platform in an attempted attack on Saudi Arabia’s southern region earlier that day. Later in the morning morning, Al-Malki announced the destruction of another ballistic missile launch platform in Dhamar. According to the Coalition, the Houthi militia had used the platform in an attempted attack on Riyadh that day.
